meta.plot: Adult animated series of original short stories which are set within the worlds of beloved video games. Each episode serves as a gateway to a new adventure, unlocking exciting worlds from beloved gaming classics and highly anticipated new titles.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Dungeons & Dragons: The Queen's Cradle
1.plot: On the hunt for a dragon cult, a band of adventurers rescues a boy who's haunted by a sinister force.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Sifu: It Takes a Life
1.plot: A young martial artist bent on revenge learns the true cost of his obsession.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - New World: The Once and Future King
1.plot: A conquering king washes ashore on a mysterious island with no army and no clue. He may need an eternity to find his purpose.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Unreal Tournament: Xan
1.plot: After revolting against their corporate overlords, a group of mining robots is condemned to fight for survival in deadly arena combat.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Warhammer 40,000: And They Shall Know No Fear
1.plot: In the grim darkness of the far future, a genetically-engineered warrior who has served on the front lines for centuries confronts his legacy, as his squad hunts down a mutant sorcerer.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - PAC-MAN: Circle
1.plot: Trapped in a vast maze and pursued by ghosts, a mysterious entity summons a warrior to help it escape.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Crossfire: Good Conflict
1.plot: As a looming storm approaches, two rival mercenary groups collide. Driven by their vision of the greater good, the sides face off, their lives hanging in the balance.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Armored Core: Asset Management
1.plot: In a frostbitten frontier world, a legendary mech pilot learns his latest mission might hold the key to the demons that have haunted him for decades.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Outer Worlds: The Company We Keep
1.plot: An orphan from a galactic backwater crosses the cosmos to take a job at a ruthless mega-corporation in the hopes of reuniting with the girl he loves.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Mega Man: Start
1.plot: As the corrupted creations of genius inventor Dr. Light rampage through Mega City, the humblest of his inventions dreams of fighting for everlasting peace.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Exodus: Odyssey
1.plot: A mechanic traverses the galactic frontier, racing against time in search of his runaway daughter.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Spelunky: Tally
1.plot: A pair of explorers ponder their purpose in a subterranean world where everything wants to kill them. Repeatedly.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Concord: Tale of the Implacable
1.plot: Captain Cassidy's crew of Freegunners is about to pull off the biggest heist of their lives – now there's only a deadly armada and a cosmos-sundering space storm between them and freedom.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Honor of Kings: The Way of All Things
1.plot: An orphaned prodigy challenges the all-knowing artificial intelligence that rules his city.

1.title: EN - Secret Level [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Playtime: Fulfillment
1.plot: Courier O is stuck in the endless drudgery of a point-chasing grind, but when a mysterious figure entrusts her with a strange package, O discovers that powerful people are determined to get their hands on it.

meta.plot: L'ancien catcheur professionnel Big Show quitte le ring et se prépare pour un challenge encore plus difficile : élever ses trois filles avec son épouse, en Floride.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E01 - Prototype
1.plot: The Big Show's teenage daughter from a previous relationship comes to live with him, his wife, Cassy, and their two younger daughters in Florida.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E02 - The Big Punisher
1.plot: The Big Show's real estate career gets off to a bad start; Mandy moves in with Lola.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E03 - The Big Brain
1.plot: JJ struggles to recognize that she's smart; Mandy runs for president; the Big Show fights his fear of mascots; Cassy bonds with Lola -- maybe too much.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E04 - The Big Sinkhole
1.plot: The Big Show and Lola compete in the kitchen; Cassy embroiders the truth at an open house; Mandy learns that not all politicians play dirty.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E05 - The Big Process
1.plot: While Cassy struggles to adjust to life with no job, Lola seeks to keep her father from spending too much time with her new boyfriend.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E06 - The Big Party
1.plot: While the Big Show takes Cassy on a wrestling cruise for their anniversary, Lola, Mandy and JJ throw a wild house party in their absence.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E07 - The Big Surprise
1.plot: Lola's best friend from Minnesota comes for a visit; Mandy and Taylor engage in a debate in front of the school; the Big Show gets back in the ring.

1.title: FR - Le Show de Big Show - S01E08 - The Big Decision
1.plot: Mandy and JJ hide a dog from their parents; Lola practices for her driving test; Cassy hires an assistant; the Big Show wrestles with a decision.

meta.plot: Reboot de la série anthologique culte des années 1980 créée par Steven Spielberg. A chaque épisode, le public est transporté dans des contrées où l'imaginaire et l’émerveillement se rencontrent, à travers le prisme des cinéastes, réalisateurs et scénaristes les plus talentueux du moment.

1.title: FR - Histoires fantastiques - S01E01 - The Cellar
1.plot: While restoring an old Iowa farmhouse, Sam discovers a time portal in the storm cellar that transports him to 1919.

1.title: FR - Histoires fantastiques - S01E02 - The Heat
1.plot: Tuka and Sterling are best friends whose bond transcends the physical world as they follow their dreams after tragedy strikes.

1.title: FR - Histoires fantastiques - S01E03 - Dynoman and the Volt
1.plot: An awkward young boy and his grandfather are transformed by the arrival of a mysterious ring ordered from a comic book 60 years ago.

1.title: FR - Histoires fantastiques - S01E04 - Signs of Life
1.plot: When her mother awakes from a six-year coma, teenage Alia struggles to reconnect with this stranger who can’t remember her old life.

1.title: FR - Histoires fantastiques - S01E05 - The Rift
1.plot: When a WWII pilot crashes in modern-day Ohio, a young widow and her stepson are swept up in his search for home. Season finale.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E01 - People Can Change
1.plot: Helena and her twin sister Siri have long lived separate lives. When a reunion approaches, Helena thanks and travels to an idyllic resort in the Italian Alps, but it quickly turns out that Siri has her own agenda with her invitation.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E02 - The Truth Will Set You Free (And Other Lies)
1.plot: Helena becomes painfully aware of Himmelsdalens main activity. Desperately, she tries to prove her true identity, but the staff of the institution dismiss her claims as another of Siri's manipulative tricks.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E03 - The Jackals Are Circling
1.plot: Doctors disagree on how to interpret "Siris" sudden behavioral improvement. Helena realizes that she can take advantage of her fellow prisoners' fear of Siri and get to know a secret organization that can pave the way for a possible escape.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E04 - Suffer The Little Children
1.plot: The doctors' actions suggest that they are beginning to take Helena's story seriously, but in fact they are just looking to confirm their own theories of treatment. Enzo understands that Helena speaks truth and shares her escape plan.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E05 - The Lord Giveth, And The Lord Taketh Away
1.plot: The young guide turns out to be anything but trustworthy, but confidence in Enzo exists. Helena gets valuable information about her sister during the sessions with Silva and a new plan to prove her identity is beginning to take shape.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E06 - Staying Alive
1.plot: Helena gets a life sign from Siri for the first time, which apparently has no plans to return. The flight is close, but first another risky mission awaits, as Helena refuses to leave the Valley of Heaven without having found the hammer.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E07 - Hail Mary
1.plot: Helena's newly won expectations are crushed when she is reached by the news of her own death, but suddenly Margot emerges with a new spark of hope. At the same time, Redpath and Fischer are trying to clear evidence in the hope of saving the facility's reputation.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E08 - Will The Circle Be Unbroken?
1.plot: Season finale. Helena wins over Silva on her side, but an accident happens when he tries to leave the facility. Now it remains only for Helena and Enzo to carry out their escape attempt - and they are both prepared to do so at all costs.

meta.plot: Siri et Héléna sont des jumelles qui ont été séparées à la naissance du fait de leur relation conflictuelle. Des années plus tard, Héléna rend visite à Siri dans une station balnéaire des Alpes. Mais, une fois sur place, elle se rend compte qu'elle a été piégée et qu'elle va se retrouver au sein d'un établissement psychiatrique désireux de faire des expérimentations...
Une adolescente cubano-américaine de douze ans souhaite devenir la future présidente des Etats-Unis. Mais, pour le moment, elle confie son quotidien de collégienne dans son journal intime.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E01 - Hello World
1.plot: Elena battles a series of curve balls at school, as she forgets to do a homework assignment for the first time ever and struggles with whether or not to keep a secret about her former best friend. Meanwhile her mom, Gabi, struggles to tell her kids about her new boyfriend, Sam.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E02 - The New Deal
1.plot: After learning Gabi has a new boyfriend, Elena worries about maintaining her role in the family. Bobby meets his match on the tennis court, and Sam helps Gabi deal with the loss of her favorite sandwich when it’s abruptly taken off the lunch menu.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E03 - Disaster Relief
1.plot: In an attempt to find her “reason for being,” Elena tries to become Orange Bay Middle’s Hurricane Watch Captain. Bobby prepares to go to “Miami Second Base” with new crush Monyca-with-a-Y. Gabi is excited to have her first real date with Sam, but family obligations keep getting in the way.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E04 - The National Mall
1.plot: In an effort to stop waiting for womanhood to come to them, Elena and Sasha stray from their usual mall stores to the forbidden Intimates & More – which leads Elena to become an accidental criminal. Bobby’s friends throw a kickback to try to help Bobby get more alone time with Monyca. Gabi tries to prove to her boss that she’s perfect for the new case at work.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E05 - Whistleblower
1.plot: When Elena learns her school mascot honors a man with a horrific past, she makes it her mission to have the mascot changed. Bobby grapples with his heritage when an opposing team member makes fun of him for the way his name is spelled. Gabi tries to find the work-life balance between a case she’s thrilled to be working on and a boss who doesn’t have boundaries.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E06 - Habeas Corpus
1.plot: When Elena gets detention, she discovers a new group of kids who are so much more than their reputation. Bobby is psyched to watch a cult classic with his buddies, but is surprised when the movie forces him to reveal an aspect of his life that he wasn’t prepared to share. Meanwhile, Gabi is bummed to have lost an important case to a bigger firm, only to be significantly cheered up by Sam.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E07 - Foreign Relations
1.plot: Elena desperately wants to go to her first middle school dance with Joey, only to find out that he would rather go with an eighth-grade girl. Bobby and Liam go to Jupiter to compete in a tennis tournament, but find their plans thwarted. Gabi is finally ready to donate the last of her late husband’s belongings, but her feelings change when she finds an old memento.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E08 - Matters of Diplomacy
1.plot: As she prepares for the big dance, Elena is shocked to discover she has a “mustache.” Attempts to fix it only make it worse, forcing her to “own” her look. Bobby and his buddies plan a prank for the dance, but when it doesn’t go the way Bobby expected, he lashes out at Liam. Gabi’s discomfort with her new relationship only grows when her mother invites the entire family over to meet Sam.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E09 - State of the Union
1.plot: Elena is shocked to discover that Sasha wants to switch roommates for the Tallahassee field trip. Desperate to run from her problems, she misses the bus on purpose, only to be driven by Gabi – who’s fleeing from her own issues with Sam. Bobby, still confused by his behavior at the dance, tells his girlfriend that he loves her.

1.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S01E10 - Two Party System
1.plot: In Tallahassee, Elena has unresolved issues with Jessica, and she decides to take a Senator’s inspiring advice, to find a solution. Bobby struggles with expressing himself and finds comfort in Sam’s guidance. Gabi tries to pretend like everything is fine at work, despite her new normal with Sam.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E01 - Back In Session
2.plot: Elena thinks she has it all figured out, but soon realizes that’s not the case.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E02 - Strategic Alliance
2.plot: Elena joins the school play to spend time with Sasha, but is dismayed when Claude also signs up.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E03 - Pleading the Fifth
2.plot: Elena enlists her Ñeñe (and Gabi’s mother) Francisca to help get her mom off her back.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E04 - United Nations
2.plot: Elena gets a lower-than-expected grade on a test and tries to get her grades up.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E05 - The National Stage
2.plot: When Sasha is overcome with stage fright, Elena to takes on the role to save the play.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E08 - Supreme Court Injustice
2.plot: Elena creates a new rebellious internet persona and loses herself a little in the process.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E09 - First Gentleman
2.plot: Elena discovers that all of her friends have already had their first kisses.

2.title: FR - Journal d'une Future Présidente - S02E10 - October Surprise
2.plot: Elena finally gets the school to change its mascot, but students turn against her in the process.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E01 - Contamination
1.plot: An epidemic looms. Anne-Marie Leclerc, director of the Emergency Public Health Laboratory, must deal with an outbreak, an overzealous cabinet minister, and a media storm. To top it off, she discovers that her husband has been deceiving her. All this is trivial compared to what’s in store...

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E02 - The Invisible Threat
1.plot: The disease continues to spread silently. For now, Anne-Marie has other worries. She sets out to prove to the Minister that her lab is effective. She’s still hesitant to confront Marc. Françoise organizes a celebration for Xavier. It’s a small gathering – with immense consequences.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E03 - Suspicion
1.plot: Nelli tells Anne-Marie that a strange illness is affecting people she’s close to. Anne-Marie initiates an investigation into the deaths of the two homeless people. The young girl infected by Nelli’s cousin risks infecting others. In the lab, the arrival of a new staffer affects Anne-Marie’s work.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E04 - The Finger on the Trigger
1.plot: The dead can’t talk. Anne-Marie needs to know if people close to the victims are suffering from the disease. The clock is ticking. The lab team does all it can to break the chain of transmission and discover the nature of the virus.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E05 - The Last Card
1.plot: Unaware that the epidemic is developing a second hot-spot, Anne-Marie focuses her energy on finding medication that will help patients. Will she go as far as breaking the law? Françoise is now in contact with Marcellin, a friend of Xavier’s who’s suffering from the same “flu.”

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E06 - Out of Control
1.plot: Cases of COVA are multiplying; enforced home quarantines number in the hundreds. Anne-Marie redoubles her efforts to contain the epidemic and limit deaths. Confined to her home, Geneviève hides her symptoms. She has one wish – to be near her hospitalized son – even if that means breaking the rules.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E07 - Consequences
1.plot: Anne-Marie combats the misinformation prompting irrational behavior. The minister no longer has faith in her and wants to be directly involved in the experimental treatment. At the lab, Nelli follows up a new lead in the investigation. Will she find the source of the virus?

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E08 - Fear
1.plot: The 200th COVA death is about to be announced. How can public panic be minimized? Montrealers are fleeing the city and ignoring symptoms. Anne-Marie needs a new strategy.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E09 - The Hens
1.plot: A drop in the number of new cases heralds the end of the epidemic. Will there be a second wave? Anne-Marie is suddenly confronted with several cases of sick people who have had no contact with infected individuals. The team works to solve the puzzle. Sabrina and Juliette sell their first ferret.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E10 - Scars
1.plot: Two days before the official announcement that the epidemic is over, the infection of two little girls brings Anne-Marie back to square one. The epidemiological investigation resumes, but the girls are uncooperative. Will Nelli get them to talk and prevent COVA from claiming more victims?

meta.plot: Un dangereux virus se répand à Montréal dans un groupe d’itinérants ostracisés et vulnérables. Combien de temps Anne-Marie Leclerc, infectiologue et directrice du Laboratoire d’urgence sanitaire, prendra-t-elle avant de réaliser l’existence de cette maladie hautement contagieuse ? Sera-t-il trop tard pour empêcher qu’une épidémie mortelle se propage dans l’ensemble de la population ?

meta.plot: L'agent de sécurité nationale Fatima reçoit une information selon laquelle une attaque terroriste contre la Suède est en cours de planification. Pendant ce temps, Sulle, une adolescente de Stockholm, s'intéresse à son assistante étudiante qui ouvre les portes d'un monde nouveau et fascinant - le vrai chemin. Kalifat est un thriller sur les destins entremêlés de cinq jeunes femmes qui sont prises dans la force séduisante et destructrice du fondamentalisme religieux.

1.plot: In an ancient kingdom, a vicious warlord is on the hunt for a magical sword. Forced to escape his soldiers, the young girl who guards the sword is hunted until she receives some unexpected help from a pair of odd strangers.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E02 - Attack of the Xuán Guǐ Zōng!
1.plot: Shāng Bù Huàn has no intention of following the sly Lǐn Xuě Yā's advice and helping in the quest to protect the mystical Tiān Xing Jiàn sword, but when finds himself targeted by the evil sect that is trying to take it, he finds he might not have a choice.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E03 - The Woman In Night Devil Forest
1.plot: To defeat the villainous Miè Tiān Hái, Dān Fěi and her party will need to get through an army of bloodthirsty undead. The safest way to do this would be to recruit the help of a necromancer, but the person that Lǐn Xuě Yā has in mind makes the others very nervous, for a good reason...

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E04 - The Whereabouts of the Soul Echo Flute
1.plot: After an attempt to recruit the otherworldly Night's Lament, the group moves to rendezvous with the owner of the Soul Echo Flute. What they find in his place spells big trouble for the enigmatic Guǐ Niǎo...

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E05 - The Sword Devil, Shā Wú Shēng
1.plot: After the group returns to their inn, they talk about confronting the Screaming Phoenix Killer. Cán Yún is determined to fight Wú Shēng in a duel the next morning, because he considers himself expendable and because, if he wins, then he would make a name for himself. Xíng Hài offers her help in the form of spells. Guǐ Niǎo, however, feels that confrontation should only be used as a last resort. Bù Huàn gets tired of the talk and decides to head off on his own. He goes to the Devilwood Flower Garden himself and asks Wú Shēng to hand over the Soul Echo Flute. Wú Shēng refuses and they prepare to battle, but Guǐ Niǎo diffuses the situation and asks Wú Shēng the favor of becoming the performer of the Soul Echo Flute; in exchange, Guǐ Niǎo propositions Wú Shēng his head once they have reached the summit of the Demon Spine Mountains. Wú Shēng agrees. Meanwhile, Miè Tiān Hái suspects that Guǐ Niǎo's group will head to him.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E06 - Seven Comrades
1.plot: Bù Huàn is worried that the group cannot work together, as everyone is suspicious of each other. However, he still accompanies them as they ride a boat to the Demon Spine Mountains. Upon arrival to shore, the group encounters the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, led by Liè Mèi and Diāo Mìng. Cán Yún is motivated by Wú Shēng to attack and takes care of the "cannon fodder," while Hài and Yún Xiāo work together to raise the dead created by Cán Yún. Wú Shēng finally attacks after all the soldiers have been taken care of, killing Liè Mèi. Suddenly, Miè Tiān Hái shows up.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E07 - Demon Spine Mountains
1.plot: The group arrives at the Demon Spine Mountains, encountering the Valley of the Dead, the first trial.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E08 - The Enigmatic Gale
1.plot: After Bù Huàn storms off, Fěi admonishes the groups and runs after him. Guǐ Niǎo also follows her. The remaining four comrades decide to pass through the Labyrinth of Darkness using the Soul Echo Flute. Guǐ Niǎo and Fěi find Bù Huàn spying on some Xuán Guǐ Zōng soldiers, who are trying to catch more demon birds. The three of them ambush the Xuán Guǐ Zōng and use a bone-whistle to call the demon birds and ride them to the Seven Sins Tower. Once they arrive, they find Tiān Hái waiting for them. Fěi immediately attacks him, seeking vengeance for her brother and to obtain the hilt of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn. However, Guǐ Niǎo sprays Fěi with smoke, causing her to attack Bù Huàn instead. Diāo Mìng then knocks out Fěi and arrests Bù Huàn. They are then thrown into cages, where they are found by the other four. Yún Xiāo reveals Guǐ Niǎo's other name, Enigmatic Gale (Lüè Fēng Qiè Chén), while Fěi reveals his real name, Lǐn Xuě Yā.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E09 - The Essence of a Sword
1.plot: Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài reveal that their letters from Lǐn Xuě Yā asked them to swindle Fěi of her crossguard. Wú Shēng affirms this with the letter he stole from Xuě Yā's teacher, Lián Qí. Cán Yún is shaken up by this turn of events, but still follows the other three as they leave Bù Huàn and Fěi in their cells. Wú Shēng returns to the Tower, though, seeking Xuě Yā's head as promised. Meanwhile, Xuě Yā and Miè Tiān Hái are having a discussion about the Tiān Xíng Jiàn. Wú Shēng interrupts this discussion, though, and before going after Xuě Yā, challenges Tiān Hái to a duel. Tiān Hái slays Wú Shēng, and explains his swordsmanship to Xuě Yā. While this happens, Bù Huàn breaks out of his cell.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E10 - A Thief's Pride
1.plot: After Bù Huàn exits his cell, he sees Wú Shēng fighting through endless streams of Xuán Guǐ Zōng fodder. Bù Huàn picks up a sword from a dead soldier and continues searching the Seven Sins Tower for Lǐn Xuě Yā. He then spots Xuě Yā and Diāo Mìng, and hides. Bù Huàn confronts Xuě Yā after Diāo Mìng leaves. Xuě Yā then explains his plan to Bù Huàn, and explains that both Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài are villains that would take the Tiān Xíng Jiàn for themselves. All Xuě Yā wants to do is make Miè Tiān Hái despair. Xuě Yā also reveals the hiding place of the crossguard—the Limitless Temple. Bù Huàn then meets with Fěi and tells her the plan and to stay in the cell. Meanwhile, Xuě Yā sets up a deal with Tiān Hái. Afterwards, Xuě Yā meets with Bù Huàn again and gives him a hood that changes his appearance to that of Xuě Yā. They then begin to carry out Xuě Yā's plan. At the same time, Cán Yún breaks Fěi out of her cell.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E11 - A Proud Life
1.plot: Bù Huàn, disguised as Xuě Yā, meets with Tiān Hái, who becomes very suspicious, and together with the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, ride their demon birds to the Limitless Temple. As this happens, Xuě Yā discovers that Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài also met with Tiān Hái. He then goes to unlock the safe containing the hilt of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, transforming his pipe into chopsticks. Erstwhile, after Bù Huàn receives the gold agreed upon for the crossguard of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, he is questioned by Tiān Hái and Diāo Mìng, who have already seen through his disguise. Bù Huàn then acts as bait to allow Xuě Yā to finish his part. However, Tiān Hái had kept the hilt on him the entire time. Meanwhile, Cán Yún and Fěi also head to the Limitless Temple by way of a Spirit Tree.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E12 - A Blade That Doesn't Cut
1.plot: After escaping, Bù Huàn happens upon Cán Yún and Fěi. He learns Yún Xiāo and Hài stole the crossguard and intend to sell it to Tiān Hái. Suddenly, Diāo Mìng and the Xuán Guǐ Zōng show up and attack the three of them. Bù Huàn shows his true colors and fights with a wooden branch. After killing Diāo Mìng and the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, Bù Huàn explains his philosophy as the three of them head to the Duàn Jiàn Cí. Meanwhile, Yún Xiāo and Hài meet with Tiān Hái at the Duàn Jiàn Cí. After removing the sword from the pedestal, Yāo Tú Lí is revealed, the lost demon god. Hài then kills Yún Xiāo for trying to prevent the awakening of the demon god. Xuě Yā confronts Tiān Hái outside the Duàn Jiàn Cí after Hài leaves.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E13 - A New Duty
1.plot: Xuě Yā duels Tiān Hái, with Xuě Yā crushing Tiān Hái's spirit. Because of this, Tiān Hái destroys the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, releasing Yāo Tú Lí from the binding. Bù Huàn decides to face Yāo Tú Lí. He defeats the demon god by channeling the power of one of the thirty-six swords he collected from his travels, and banishes the demon god to the far reaches of space, ending the threat once and for all. He leaves the sword in the care of Cán Yún and Fěi, and departs, but not before receiving a parting gift from Xuě Yā.

meta.plot: Pouvoir voir les fantômes et autres esprits surnaturels est une lourde responsabilité. Le prince Lee Rin (Jung Il Woo), comme son père avant lui, découvre qu'il est capable de voir des fantômes et d'autres êtres surnaturels. Fort de ses nouvelles capacités, Lee Rin devient le chef d'un groupe de gardes de nuit qui patrouillent dans les rues du crépuscule à l'aube pour protéger les habitants de la dynastie Chosun contre les mauvais esprits. Moo Seok (Jung Yun Ho) est le meilleur épéiste du pays, qui est le fidèle garde du corps du prince. Mais leur loyauté sera mise à l'épreuve lorsqu'ils tomberont amoureux l'un de l'autre de la même femme - Do Ha (Go Sung Hee), successeur de la tribu des Ma Go, qui cherche leur aide pour protéger les esprits de la montagne Baek Do. Mais Park Soo Ryun (Seo Ye Ji), fille d'un officier de justice, ne recule devant rien pour épouser le prince Lee Rin. «Le gardien de nuit», également connu sous le nom de «Journal d'un gardien de nuit»

1.plot: Three new protectors have the book in Bay City. The first thing Zoe, Ish and Leo learn is that the magic doesn't always work like you want it to.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E02 - Just Add Numbers
1.plot: A clue sends Ish and Zoe to a mysterious section of the library while Leo uses the magic to bond with his family.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E03 - Just Add Dad
1.plot: In attempt to connect with a relative, Zoe cooks a recipe that will allow her to relive memories from when she was a baby.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E04 - Just Add Coin
1.plot: The trio must hide a magical coin from the Wesson family. In the process, the spell begins to hide other important items from their life.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E05 - Just Add Volume
1.plot: The protectors cook a super-hearing spell in order to hear what song a silent music box is playing.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E06 - Just Add Grown-Ups
1.plot: Zoe, Ish, and Leo pretend to be adults for the day to obtain information about the Wessons and Zoe's dad.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E07 - Just Add Foresight
1.plot: The trio cooks up a magic recipe that allows them to see into the future in order to stay one step ahead of the Wessons.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E08 - Just Add Color
1.plot: Everything turns to black and white while the protectors find out what the three magic coins are for.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E09 - Just Add Waffles
1.plot: Zoe, Ish, and Leo are joined by Kelly, Hannah and Darbie to discover the location of the magical starter.

1.title: FR - Just add Magic : Mystery City - S01E10 - Just Add Goodbyes
1.plot: Bay City is in danger after the Wessons get the final ingredient to a powerful spell. Can our protectors stop them in time?

meta.plot: Dans une société qui valorise les gagnants, comment gérer l'échec ? Cette série s'intéresse aux athlètes qui ont transformé leur défaite cuisante en triomphe humain.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E01 - The Miscast Champion
1.plot: Forced into boxing by his abusive father, Michael Bentt became a world champ. But a knockout loss changes his life and helps him find his true passion.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E02 - The Jaws of Victory
1.plot: On the verge of relegation — and perhaps extinction — English soccer club Torquay United gets a final chance at survival thanks to a police dog.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E03 - Judgement
1.plot: Surya Bonaly dazzled figure skating fans with her skill, but being black in a mostly white sport made it tough to be fairly judged on the world stage.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E04 - Stone Cold
1.plot: An unbelievable loss in the 1985 Canadian championship leads curling legend Pat Ryan to perfect a dominant strategy that changes the sport forever.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E05 - Lost in the Desert
1.plot: After a sandstorm takes him off course, Olympian Mauro Prosperi's attempt to finish a brutal desert endurance race turns into a battle for survival.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E06 - Aliy
1.plot: Sled dog musher Aliy Zirkle spent years chasing a title in the famous Iditarod, but a harrowing experience on the trail in 2016 tested her fortitude.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E07 - Black Jack
1.plot: Playground hoops legend Jack Ryan’s shot at a pro career was sunk by a bad attitude and poor discipline, but he persevered to make a life in basketball.

1.title: FR - Losers - S01E08 - The 72nd Hole
1.plot: Golfer Jean van de Velde reflects on both the heartbreak and positives that came from his epic failure on the last hole of the 1999 Open Championship.

meta.plot: In the near future, a sudden and unexplained sea rise has left much of human civilization underwater. Ikaruga Natsuki, a boy who lost his mother and one of his legs in an accident some years earlier, returns disillusioned from a harsh life in the big city to find his old countryside home half-swallowed by the sea. Left without a family, all he has to his name is the ship and submarine left to him by his oceanologist grandmother, and her debts. His only hope to restore the dreams for the future that he has lost is to take up an opportunity presented to him by the suspicious debt collector Catherine. They set sail to search the sunken ruins of his grandmother's laboratory in order to find a treasure rumor says she left there. But what they find is not riches or jewels; it is a strange girl lying asleep in a coffin at the bottom of the sea, Atri. Atri is a robot, but her appearance and her wealth of emotions would fool anyone into thinking she's a living, breathing human being.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - To the Cradle in the Ocean
1.plot: In the near future, much of the world has been forgotten at the bottom of the ocean due to rising sea levels. Natsuki Ikaruga, who lives in a small town surrounded and stranded by the sea, is invited by a mysterious woman, Catherine, to search for a treasure in his grandmother's house who was a marine geologist. One day, he dives to the bottom of the ocean in a submarine and encounters a mysterious capsule with a girl sleeping inside. The girl was a humanoid so sophisticated that she could be mistaken for a human.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Warm View Together
1.plot: "I'll be your leg, Master!" Atri, who was supposed to be with Cathrine, has come back to Natsuki. Although she was pumped to be of assistance to her new master, she fell into the ocean while carrying him and failed at cooking… It's as if she is a piece of scrap. Atri seems to have received a very important order from Nonko and tries to remember what it is, but...

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Hitman Small Fry School
1.plot: Natsuki accompanies Atri who is on her way to school. However, when they arrive, they find that most of the school is underwater. Although they managed to get into the school building, inside it was full of empty classrooms and an unexpected teacher. There, Natsuki is faced with the saddening reality of the lives of the people who remained in their town.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Crabs and Electricity Are Important
1.plot: Natsuki sets his heart on creating a tidal power generator that utilizes the ebb and flow of the ocean's tides. He dives back into the ocean to find some materials and salvages some resin from the ruins of Ryuuji's family's factory. As soon as he gets back he gets to work. As they are working, Natsuki and Ryuuji exchange heated opinions over how the generator should be built. Atri intervenes and the two guys become closer friends. Meanwhile, a suspicious-looking character peeks at them from outside of the school...

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Smiling Under the Night Light
1.plot: If Natsuki sells Atri, he can get batteries. However, he can no longer think of Atri as just an average humanoid. While he's deep in thought on the dock, looking out at the ocean, Natsuki finds Catherine floating in the water. She is completely intoxicated, and Natsuki and Atri take her in. But right at that time, the sound of a gunshot echoes within the silent ship.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Song Inside My Head
1.plot: Natsuki's life experiences a big shift after becoming a teacher and starting a salvaging service. Rumors of a school lit with electricity attracts new students, and activities around the school regain a sense of liveliness.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Toaster on a Date
1.plot: Was Natsuki's first love, Atri? His beautiful childhood memories are gradually being overwritten. Despite his unwillingness to admit it was her the facts around him are lining up to force him to, but he continues to deny it.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Rippling Night Has Come
1.plot: Natsuki has been acting strange and seems to have his head in the clouds through everything he does. After being interrogated by Minamo and the others, he reluctantly confesses to them that he kissed Atri in the ocean.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Leg Falling into the Abyss
1.plot: Natsuki happens to see Atri's log that was left open. What was written there was an emotionless record of how she carried out her actions to fulfill Natsuki's desires. Natsuki instinctively rejects Atri and is no longer able to trust anything. Meanwhile, a single letter arrives, and inside there is a report describing the truth behind the Humanoid called Atri.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Eventually When the Rain Stops
1.plot: When Natsuki comes to the rescue for the now-beaten-up Atri, he becomes the next target of Yasuda’s acts of violence. With the onslaught of consecutive attacks, he finds himself also beaten up, just like Atri. Before Yasuda can inflict any more pain, Atri, unable to tolerate watching any longer, raises her fist against a human once more.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The End of Summer and Your Sound
1.plot: Natsuki decides to head back to the Academy on the mainland to study humanoids. He decides to leave the salvaging service in Ryuuji's hands, and while he’s tidying up the ship in order to pass it on to him.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Ticket to the Place We Promised
1.plot: Atri's last order that was given to her by the capsule was to go to Eden. However, Natsuki and the rest are perplexed by the incomplete set of instructions and don’t know where to even start looking.

1.title: EN - ATRI -My Dear Moments- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Stop, Time... You Are Beautiful

meta.plot: Hailing from a prestigious noble house, Dali Delico is an elite member of the Blood Pact Council, the highest governing body of the Vamps. Yet, Dali flatly refuses a mission the Vamps assign him. As Dali’s motives and possible connection to mysterious murders begin to mount, council members Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique visit him in hopes he’ll reconsider, but find him soothing an infant child!

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Welcome to the Nursery
1.plot: Dali Delico is an aristocratic vampire who's been neglecting his duties at work. When some of his associates visit him one day to confront him about it, however, they find him taking care of a small child...

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Creeping Intrigue and Child-Rearing
1.plot: In exchange for agreeing to accept the case, Dali demands that the investigators establish their base of operations in his nursery, forcing them to help with both the mission and child-rearing.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Approaching Shadow
1.plot: Pendulum, a criminal organization that worships the progenitor vampire known as TRUMP, now seems to be involved in the case—and Dali just so happens to have some unfinished business with them.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Curse Called Love
1.plot: Dali's son Raphael has entered his long-dreaded rebellious phase. Envious of the attention Dali is lavishing on his younger son, Ul, Raphael jealously wishes for his little brother's death...

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Second Nursery
1.plot: Wary of potential Pendulum strike on the Delico residence, the men send the children to stay with Clara, the Delico nanny. But something strange is happening to the oldest child, Theodore...

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A Small Adventure
1.plot: Clara and the others are baffled by young Theodore showing signs of entering his cocoon phase at such an early age. Meanwhile, the other children take Ul with them for a little adventure outside the manor.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Battle Amidst Flames
1.plot: Dali and company go to retrieve the children from their little adventure, but they may end up having to fight harder than expected to get their kids back...

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Thus Spoke Juras
1.plot: After he deduces that the bandaged member of Pendulum, Juras, is a survivor of Nebula Village, Dali seeks out another known survivor in pursuit of a lead.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Battle of Gray Cat Town
1.plot: Dali learns from Banri that Juras is in Gray Cat Town. Meanwhile, the members of Pendulum, who've taken the children hostage, find that they have their hands full looking after them.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - How to Kill God
1.plot: Dali and his team uncover Pendulum's hideout and rescue Lord Johannes along with the children, but now Clara and Ul have been kidnapped...

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Clan Festival
1.plot: Pendulum is after a teacher by the name of Krauss—TRUMP's alter ego. In order to prevent them from making contact, Dali and the team rush to the Clan.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Sweet Dreams
1.plot: As a dhampir, Juras doesn't have long left to live. In an attempt to kill TRUMP before he expires, he uses his cocoon phase power to enter the deity's mind.

1.title: EN - Delico's Nursery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - End of the Nursery

meta.plot: The story revolves around Duke Fleed who is a survivor of the Vega Star, raised by Dr. Umon as his adoptive son, and known as Daisuke Umon on Earth. Years after his arrival, he's faced with the threat of King Vega and his army, who want to conquer the Earth. With his friends Koji and Hikaru (and later his kid sister Maria Grace), Duke decides to fight back using his best weapon, the almighty Grendizer.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Brothers of the Universe
1.plot: Koji Kaboto tries his OVT that he made with pieces of mecano. When flying, he is attacked by the UFOs of Vega. Fortunately Duke Fleed arrives on time to save the day (but not too quickly nonetheless). Koji does not actually know that Duke Fleed is the prince of Fleed.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Prince of the Other World
1.plot: Koji discovers the identity of the Duke Fleed, but has no time to ask questions because Vega attacks. Duke Fleed and Koji unite their power and push back the enemy.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Tragic Fiesta
1.plot: Dampee Makeeba organizes a party at the ranch and invites Koji and Duke Fleed. The latter has no time to eat anything because Vega attacks. Will he have the time to make it to Grendizer before the earth is ravaged? All bets are open...

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Island of Fear
1.plot: Gandal wants to discover the hiding place of Grendizer. So he launches a massive attack. Koji tries to confront the enemies alone, but he only succeeds to crush himself on a deserted island. Finally Duke Fleed makes it there and saves the day.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Pitfall of Death
1.plot: Koji, Hikaro, Goro and Bunta are taken in hostage. Actarus interrupts his siesta to free them.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Attack on Perlepolis
1.plot: Hikaro leaves for Perlepolis with Bunta. Their bus is attacked by a monster of Vega. Koji distracts the monster the time that Duke Fleed arrives (Grendizer has trouble to start up in winter).

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Feast of the Wolves
1.plot: Janus, from the fearsome Ruins' Division, attacks Grendizer that is powerless in front of the brutality and the agility of his enemy.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Radars are Off
1.plot: Blaki sets a trap to Grendizer by hiding mines in a cloud of spatial dust. Koji falls in the trap. Fortunately Duke Fleed helps him and destroys the Golgoth 8.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Black Moon Camp
1.plot: Koji is captured with his UFO by the Vegans. Grendizer attacks the camp of the black Moon to save him.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Vega's Spy
1.plot: An inhabitant of the planet Rubi is contacted by Vega to explode the UFO carrier of Grendizer. The mission fails because of Duke Fleed and the Vegans try to kill the Rubinian. But Duke Fleed flies to his help.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Day when the Sun will Stop
1.plot: The Vegans plan is to bring Grendizer to the shadow of the moon during the eclipse because Grendizer's systems will shut down temporarily under it and then destroy it.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Blood on Snow
1.plot: Daisuke and Kogi are sent to investigate an avalanche and to find survivors. They find a girl named Mirana who lost her memory. Back at Space Science Centre she begins to remember how a saucer destroyed her home.

1.title: EN - UFO Robot Grendizer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - By Iron and by Fire
1.plot: A new Vegan mecha comes to destroy Earth. It sucks power from the sun and burns everything in its path. Grendizer is damaged by it and has to withdraw. As the mecha attacks again Grendizer has to go to battle weaponless.

meta.plot: Meet the girls on the losing side of romance! First is Anna Yanami, the girl-next-door type who can’t say no to delicious food. Then there’s Lemon Yakishio, a beautiful and spirited athlete. Last but not least is Chika Komari, the cute yet shy heroine with gentle charm. Together, they navigate awkward setbacks hoping to finally find love!

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Professional Childhood Friend Yanami Anna's Style of Losing
1.plot: Nukumizu Kazuhiko, a loner with a love for light novels, accidentally sees popular Yanami Anna being rejected by her childhood friend. This leads to unexpected interactions with other seemingly defeated girls like Yakishio Lemon from the track team and Komari Chika from the literature club.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Promised Failure for You
1.plot: Lemon goes to the gym storage room to talk to Nukumizu. They get locked in but are rescued just before they pass out from the heat. Lemon's crush Mitsuki shows up at the nurse's office with a get well gift. Later, the two visit the lit club together...

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Losing the Battle Before It Is Ever Fought
1.plot: Lemon and Yanami join the literature club. Pressured by the student council to demonstrate their club activities, Tamaki and Koto decide that everyone should write and submit web novels. The members head to the beach together for a weekend training camp.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - When You Stare Into a Losing Heroine, the Losing Heroine Stares Back Into You
1.plot: Komari confesses to Tamaki and then runs away. Tensions between Tamaki and Koto also flare up. Koto packs her things and leaves the campground.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Asagumo Chihaya Is Led Astray
1.plot: Nukumizu endures a chaotic few days of being constantly distracted by his sister Kaju and Yanami. One afternoon, Yanami invites Nukumizu to a café and the two spot Lemon and Ayano hanging out together.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Let Any One of You Who Has Never Been Dumped Be the First to Throw a Stone at the Losing Heroine
1.plot: Nukumizu gets grilled by Ayano after being caught together with Chihaya. Nukumizu clears things up, but then for whatever reason Nukumizu, Ayano, Chihaya, Lemon, and Yanami end up hanging out together.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Other Side of a Happy Ending
1.plot: Lemon opens up to Nukumizu about her complex feelings for Ayano. She decides to clear things up with Ayano and Chihaya. She asks Nukumizu to escort her to her former elementary school at night to secretly meet Ayano and finally tell him the honest truth.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - If You Are in Trouble, Feel Free to Consult
1.plot: Nukumizu, Yanami, and Komari go to town to research a theme for their Tsuwabuki Festival exhibit. They successfully find a new club advisor and preparations seem to be going smoothly...

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Consider Your Teacher a Stain on the Ceiling or Something, and Please Continue
1.plot: Having settled on "Edible Readings" for the literature club exhibit, Nukumizu and Komari continue preparing for the Tsuwabuki Festival. When the two stop by the local library to return some reference books, they notice Tamaki and Koto on a date together.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - I Suppose It's a Bit Too Early for Goodbye
1.plot: Nukumizu and friends manage to complete the literature club exhibit in time. Once the festival begins, the exhibit draws a constant stream of visitors. Yanami steps in to give Nukumizu and Komari a break to go explore the other events on campus together.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Let's Have a Talk About Responsibility
1.plot: Komari practices her presentation for the club presidents' meeting, but still has trouble talking due to her intense fear of public speaking. Nukumizu tries to throw her a lifeline, but it turns into an argument and she runs away from him in frustration.

1.title: EN - Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Am I Actually Just Some Unseasoned Rando Who Drops In for the Last Episode with the Losing Heroine?
1.plot: Yanami asks Nukumizu to arrange an adult date. As Yanami's old friends are gradually realizing that she doesn't actually have a steady boyfriend, she wants to maintain her charade with a fake date.

meta.plot: In a world where humans triumphed in a great war, Kai guards sealed crypts containing their enemies. But when “World Rebirth” overwrites history, he’s thrust into an alternate reality where humanity lost the war and he’s been forgotten by everyone he knows. Now, this lost hero must rise to restore the world’s balance!

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Boy Forgotten by the World
1.plot: Kai's duty as a member of the Human Protection Agency is to ensure that the four races from The Great War are kept sealed in their graveyards. Humanity has been at peace for 100 years, until one day a portal opens and the world he's known ceases to exist.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Rinne
1.plot: In the graveyard where the demons were entombed in his world, Kai finds a girl whom he cannot identify as any of the known races. When she asks him for help, he doesn't hesitate for long. After freeing her from her chains, mysterious things happen again.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Hero of the Demons
1.plot: After the demon attack on Neo Vishal, the resistance launches a major offensive against the demons and their heroine with the help of Kai and Rinne. But will Kai's knowledge from his world and Rinne's powers be enough to defeat the demons?

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Thus, the World Was Recorded
1.plot: While Kai and Rinne confront the heroine of the demons, one of those mysterious beings reappears and tries to remove Vanessa from the world. However, Vanessa manages to fight it off. She then turns her attention back to Kai and Rinne.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - To the East of the World
1.plot: After finally driving the demons out of the capital, Urza's resistance sets out for the Federation of Io, whose resistance has requested support against the divine beings. However, it quickly becomes clear that not everyone welcomes this support.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Elven Forest
1.plot: Jeanne and Urza's resistance encounter remnants of the Io resistance in the Elfan Forest. Following the trail, they arrive at the Elf Village, where the leader of the elves is already waiting to present them with a proposal.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Heartless Angel
1.plot: Urza's resistance, along with Reiren, confronts the Lord of the Heavens, Alfreya, who is attempting to subjugate the divine beings. However, Alfreya appears to possess powers that surpass even those of a hero.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Celestial Purgatory
1.plot: Once again, a Last Riser seems to be connected to the sudden change in a hero's nature. Will Kai and his companions be able to defeat Alfreya? And what impact will this have on the relationship between humans and the divine beings?

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Center of the World
1.plot: The spirit hero, "Spirit Sovereign Rikugen Kyoko" and the mythical beast hero, "Fang King Rath=IE" face off, with the fate of their races in the balance. Meanwhile, Kai and his companions head south to the Yulun Federation.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Prophet of This World
1.plot: Guided by a mysterious voice, Kai, Rinne, and Jeanne enter Megalith. Awaiting them at the end is a stone statue of The Prophetic God Arsla Solaka. Kai is confused as he thought the Prophetic God was nothing more than a legend.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - To Where Fate Lies
1.plot: The resistance gets into a battle against the heroine of the spirit beings, but in the midst of it, a Last Riser appears. After the battle, they decide to get to the bottom of the mystery of the Last Risers. And so they proceed to the next tomb.

1.title: EN - Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Those Who Shatter the Endless Cycle of World Reincarnation
1.plot: A battle begins between Last Riser and Kai with Kyoko’s aid. Rinne, frozen out of fear, recalls her past with Sid. They manage to lure the monster out of the graveyard as all the races join forces to defeat one enemy; The enemy of the world, Last Riser.

meta.plot:
The distant future, 5012.

The sudden aerial invasion of Earth by ＜Aliens＞ and their creations ＜Machine Lifeforms＞ led mankind to the brink of extinction. The surviving number of humans who took refuge on the moon to organize a counterattack using ＜android＞ soldiers to recapture Earth.

However, the war reaches a stalemate as the ＜Machine Lifeforms＞ continue to multiply infinitely. In turn, humanity deploys anew unit of android soldiers as an ultimate weapon: ＜YoRHa＞

Newly dispatched to Earth ＜2B＞ joins ＜9S＞, the analyst currently stationed there, where amid their mission, they encounter a myriad of mysterious phenomena...

This is the story of these lifeless ＜androids＞ and their endless fight for the sake of mankind.

1.title: EN - NieR:Automata Ver1.1a [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - or not to [B]e
1.plot:
▶▶ Report: Pod 042

5012 AD.

Lifeforms otherwise known as ＜Aliens＞ begin their invasion of Earth.

Since mankind escaped to the moon, the ground battle between the ＜androids＞ created by humans and the ＜Machine Lifeforms＞ created by the Aliens has continued for a long time.

This craft is the accompanying support unit entitled ＜Pod 042＞.

In the 243rd Descent Operation held March 10, 11945, this unit will support Android ＜2B＞ of the ＜YoRHa Soldiers＞. Thereafter, this unit will report regular mission status in tandem with ＜Pod 153＞, the unit supporting YoRHa Aircraft Solider ＜9S＞ in this joint operation.

1.plot:

The machine lifeform found a small ring of flowers.

The machine lifeform felt a mysterious ＜Something＞ beginning to be born within it.

1.plot:

D'Artagnan is taken captive along with the rioting refugees, and the other Musketeers (along with D'Artagnan's wife Constance, now in charge of the Musketeer garrison) must rescue them from the hands of the Red Guard before they are executed.

The Duke informs the corrupt Governor of this, and the Governor's Red Guard must race the Musketeers in the hunt for the thief.

meta.plot:
En 2040, Agatha et ses deux frères jumeaux Dash et Arthur ont la capacité unique de prédire le futur, notamment de prévoir les meurtres avant qu'ils ne soient perpétrés. 

Sous la supervision de scientifiques, Precrime les a isolé pour exploiter leurs dons et ainsi stopper de nombreux crimes avant qu'ils ne surviennent. 

En 2065, maintenant dans leurs trentaines, la fratrie a été libérée et Precrime démantelé. 

Arthur a malheureusement été séparé de son frère et sa soeur. 

Toujours hanté par des flashs lui montrant le sort funeste de nombreuses victimes, Dash tente en vain d'en sauver au moins une. 

Mais sans son frère, son don est incomplet. 

Un enchaînement de circonstances l'amène à collaborer avec une enquêtrice, Lara Vega. 

Ensemble, ils vont s'efforcer d'arrêter les criminels, tout en préservant le secret de Dash.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E05 - Employee of the Bearimy
4.plot: Michael and Jason sneak into Demon-Con. Left in charge of the neighborhood, Eleanor copes with Derek's ineptitude and Tahani's dissatisfaction.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E06 - A Chip Driver Mystery
4.plot: After Brent writes an offensive book, Eleanor, Michael and the others try to help him evolve. One of the humans discovers Jason's true identity.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E07 - Help is Other People
4.plot: With one day left in the year, Simone reveals that she's suspicious about the neighborhood -- and her investigation could derail the entire experiment.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E08 - The Funeral to End All Funerals
4.plot: As the Judge hears Michael and Shawn's arguments about the results of the experiment, Janet and the humans give each other the funerals they deserved.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E09 - The Answer
4.plot: With time running out to find answers, Chidi must sort through his life -- and afterlives -- before he can provide the help everyone needs.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E10 - You've Changed, Man
4.plot: The group scrambles to devise a new afterlife system that the Good and Bad Places can agree on before it's too late. Chidi has a newfound confidence.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E11 - Mondays, Am I Right?
4.plot: While the humans search for test candidates, Michael trains a group of architects. Eleanor doesn't want Chidi to learn too much about her past.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E12 - Patty
4.plot: Arriving at a new place, Michael receives an unexpected honor. Meanwhile, the rest of the group explores — and learns a shocking truth.

4.title: FR - The Good Place - S04E13 - Whenever You're Ready
4.plot: Michael works with the Joint Council of Afterlife Affairs to smooth out kinks in the system. Jason and Tahani move on. Eleanor tries to influence Chidi.

meta.plot: Pour la liberté retrace l'histoire du Lt Sodhi et de ses troupes d'hommes et de femmes qui se sont battus héroïquement pour l'indépendance de l'Inde, au sein de l'Armée Nationale Indienne. Armée formée à la suite de la défaite Britannique à Singapour, pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, et menée par le chef charismatique qu'était "Netaji" Subhash Chandra Bose.

1.title: FR - Le Combat Oublié - S01E01 - Shonan
1.plot: An introverted old man (Old Sodhi) has come to visit his sister (Urmila) and her family, Subhash (Urmila’s son) and Amar (Subhash’s son) in Singapore. In an intervention by his older sister, Old Sodhi is catapulted into his past, the war of ’42, the past he was running away from. He narrates the controversial outcome of the Battle of Singapore and fate of the soldiers of the British Indian Army.

1.title: FR - Le Combat Oublié - S01E02 - POW
1.plot: After surrendering, the fate of the soldiers depended on the mercy of the Japanese Army. The Indian soldiers transformed when Netaji gave the call to form the Indian National Army. Maya, an aspiring photographer, is driven to join this freedom army. Sodhi and Arshad realise that India is their motherland and that they have to fight to free her from British raj.

1.title: FR - Le Combat Oublié - S01E03 - Chalo Dilli
1.plot: Maya and Rasammah enroll in the women’s regiment. Rajan and many other civilians also enroll in the INA. Rigorous training sessions begin for all the recruits. In 1996, Amar reaches Burma with Old Sodhi and they meet Rani (Amar’s Burmese friend). Circumstances lead to Old Sodhi shooting a Burmese soldier which paves way for a chain reaction of dangerous events.

1.title: FR - Le Combat Oublié - S01E04 - Harakiri
1.plot: Maya and Sodhi along with the INA soldiers do not give hope even after their trains are bombed by planes. Old Sodhi finds himself in Rangoon that leads to an array of past events - the struggles of the Indian soldiers and the rains that destroyed everything. Under such a situation, the Japanese were ordered to retreat.

1.title: FR - Le Combat Oublié - S01E05 - Maya
1.plot: There is an attack on the advanced base camp by the British Air Force but that doesn't deter the soldiers from marching ahead to stop the British from advancing. Sodhi orders all the wounded to retreat along with the Rani Jhansi Regiment. Old Sodhi injures his leg in the jungle and is unable to walk any further. Amar leaves with Rani to get help but are stopped on the tracks by a loud blast.

meta.plot: Plusieurs années ont passé depuis que Sali et Paul Aloka, un couple noir, ont adopté Benjamin, un enfant blanc. C’est aujourd’hui un garçon de 14 ans, qui a aussi un petit frère de 13 ans, Noé, conçu de manière naturelle. Autant dire que les Aloka ne passent pas inaperçus...

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: It's back to school for Benjamin and Noé who find themselves in the same class. Sali is job-hunting, whilst Paul is still a florist. When Lazare, to whom Paul hasn't spoken for years, arrives unexpectedly from the Côte d'Ivoire, the happy balance of the family is put under considerable strain.

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Lazare's arrival awakens a desire in Benjamin to find his biological parents. Noé falls secretly in love with Emma, but she seems to only have eyes for Benjamin. Paul discovers the real reason for Lazare's sudden arrival. Sali is torn between her search for a job and her family life.

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: It's bad news for Benjamin in his search of his biological parents. Sali sees her professional hopes dashed one after another. And as for Paul, he decides to let Lazare live with them.

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Sali, Lazare and Mamita try to obtain confidential information about Benjamin's biological parents. The latter heads off to the country with Manu and learns more about is his relationship with Prune. Noé rehearses for his piano audition and tries to find a way to make Emma like him.

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Sali and Paul discover the true identity of Benjamin's biological mother. Noé is upset when he realizes that Emma doesn't return his feelings. Lazare risks deportation from France and Paul does everything he can to help him.

1.title: FR - Il a déjà tes yeux - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Benjamin wants all his immediate family to come with him to Normandy to meet his biological mother, Ève. During the journey, Paul and Sali see their relationship tested time and again. Parents and children both need to get their family back on a more stable footing.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E01 - Epic 1: The Gosei Angels Descend
1.plot: A boy named Nozomu encounters Alata, a Gosei Angel in training who tries to help give him confidence even as he and his four teammates face the onslaught of the invaders of Warstar.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E02 - Epic 2: Fantastic Goseigers
1.plot: Hyde tries to take advantage of a rare opportunity to return to Gosei World even as Nozomu and other humans become abducted by another Warstar Insect Monster.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E03 - Epic 3: Landick Power, Divided
1.plot: Moune desperately tries to prove herself to her older brother Agri, even as it leads to trouble for the Landicks against a freezing Warstar Insect.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E04 - Epic 4: Echo, Song of the Angels
1.plot: A musical Warstar Insect disables the Skyick duo with its noise, even as Eri may have the key to stopping its destructive concert.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E05 - Epic 5: Magical Hyde
1.plot: The analytic Hyde and the impatient Agri help a doctor try to find the cure to a Warstar Insect malady changing kids into Bibi Soldiers.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E06 - Epic 6: Breakout Goseigers
1.plot: Alata tries to learn a gymnastic move to prove to Nozomu he can do it too even as Dereputa begins targeting him once again.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E07 - Epic 7: Protect the Land!
1.plot: After losing Eri in a bet, Agri is forced to work for an old farmer in order to get her back from him.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E08 - Epic 8: Gosei Power, Out of Control
1.plot: The bizarre ability of a Warstar Insect makes Alata lose complete control of his invocation abilities, making his Gosei Cards become unpredictable!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E09 - Epic 9: Gotcha☆Gosei Girls
1.plot: The incompatible Eri and Moune are stuck working together to save the male Goseiger after they become captured by a dominating female Warstar Insect.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E10 - Epic 10: Hyde's Partner
1.plot: When the enemy who killed his partner re-emerges, Hyde decides to pursue him at the cost of losing the concept of what he is fighting for as a Goseiger.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E11 - Epic 11: Spark, Landick Power
1.plot: Moune's desire to support a girl undergoing surgery is threatened when a Warstar Insect steals the electricity from the hospital, forcing her and Datas to use a unique method to overcome this.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E12 - Epic 12: The Miraculous Gosei Headder Great Assembly
1.plot: When the Goseiger become too worked up when both Mons Drake and Dereputa come down to destroy Earth, Master Head pulls them away to force them to discover what is on their side.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E13 - Epic 13: Run! The Mystic Runner
1.plot: When Eri discovers a Skick ability only Alata knows, she undertakes a surprising training regiment in order to learn how to do it.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E14 - Epic 14: Birth of the Ultimate Tag!
1.plot: Moune and Hyde must put aside their differences when they become trapped within a powerful Warstar Insect's dimensional gate with no apparent means of escape.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E15 - Epic 15: Countdown! The Life of the Earth
1.plot: When Mons Drake performs a final act which gives the Earth 24 hours before its end, the Goseiger must confront the leader of Warstar to save their planet before Earth is destroyed!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E16 - Epic 16: Dynamic Alata
1.plot: As the Goseiger celebrate the end of Warstar, a powerful enemy returns to destroy the team and to finish off his greatest rival: Alata!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E17 - Epic 17: A New Enemy! The Yuumajuu
1.plot: A foreboding discovery and the mysterious deaths of famous celebrities force the Goseiger to face a powerful, ancient opponent, while gaining unexpected assistance from a mysterious warrior who once fought them!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E18 - Epic 18: The Earth Purifying Knight of Destiny
1.plot: The Goseiger try to understand Gosei Knight and his desire to destroy human society for its ills as a propeganda-spewing Yuumajuu takes over the airwaves.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E19 - Epic 19: Gosei Knight Will Not Allow It
1.plot: Agri feels sorry for himself when he lets a family become separated by a Yuumajuu working with Buredoran to manipulate Gosei Knight's power for themselves.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E20 - Epic 20: Fall In Love Goseigers
1.plot: The Goseiger take on a challenge to help a boy get a girl to go out with him as a Yuumajuu uses its power to ruin lovers.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E21 - Epic 21: Elegant Eri
1.plot: When a baker is hurt during a Yuumajuu attack, Eri takes over the shop to make a particular cake for a special customer.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E22 - Epic 22: Over the Rainbow
1.plot: When the Yuumajuu who sealed away Gosei Knight 10,000 years ago returns, the rogue Headder tries to handle the battle on his own while continuing to see the modern Goseiger in his way.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E23 - Epic 23: Burn! Goseigers
1.plot: The male Goseiger must come to the rescue of the females and the Amachi when a Yuumajuu makes them overheat on vacation in a plot to burn Earth.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E24 - Epic 24: Miracle Attack Goseigers
1.plot: The Goseiger try to prevent Buredoran from obtaining an ancient Gosei power known for its destructive potential but remaining untamed.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E25 - Epic 25: Nostalgic Moune
1.plot: Moune lets her guard down when a Yuumajuu takes the form of her mother in order to lure her away from the other Goseiger.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E26 - Epic 26: The Laughing Gosei Angels
1.plot: Hyde and Gosei Knight become an unlikely combo who must save the other Goseiger from a Yuumajuu who captures anyone who laughs.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E27 - Epic 27: Wake Up Agri!
1.plot: A Yuumajuu exposes Agri's insecurities making him believe that the other Goseiger find him worthless to their team.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E28 - Epic 28: A Father's Treasure
1.plot: Professor Amachi worries about the welfare of Nozomu after a Yuumajuu hypnotizes him into becoming one of its emotionless servants.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E29 - Epic 29: The Goseigers are Sealed!
1.plot: Buredoran gains access to the Yuumajuu's Erurei Box in order to seal the Goseiger's Miracle Headders, but also to prepare for even bigger ambitions.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E30 - Epic 30: Romantic Eri
1.plot: Eri becomes trapped within a dream-stealing Yuumajuu where she becomes the only hope of those who have lost their way.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E31 - Epic 31: Never Give Up, Goseigers!
1.plot: Makuin merges his power with the Erurei Box, creating an indestructible platoon that can only be defeated if the Goseiger can stop him!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E32 - Epic 32: Perform the Ultimate Miracle!
1.plot: Kingong releases the final phase of the Yuumajuu's ultimate plot, forcing the Goseiger to enter into a risky scenario in order to stop their plan once and for all!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E33 - Epic 33: The Dreadful Matrintis Empire
1.plot: Nozomu inquires the Goseiger about their current status after the fall of the Yuumajuu while a new enemy uses their research of the Goseiger to start their own invasion schemes.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E34 - Epic 34: Gosei Knight Justice
1.plot: Nozomu makes GoseiKnight question his purpose in order to convince him to help the Goseiger face down the Matrintis forces.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E35 - Epic 35: Find the Perfect Leader!
1.plot: When a Matroid criticizes the Goseigers' lack of hierarchy, they decide to figure out which of them should be the leader of their team.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E36 - Epic 36: Run, Agri!
1.plot: Agri undergoes special training in order to protect a runner from a Matrintis plot to turn athletes into mecha-humans.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E37 - Epic 37: Excited Moune
1.plot: Moune must find a way to keep her calm after she obtains a brace from a Matroid which will petrify her if she gets too emotional.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E38 - Epic 38: Alice vs. Gosei Knight
1.plot: Gosei Knight tries to comprehend the importance of connections as Metal Alice goes on a rampage to destroy human society the Goseiger must put a stop to.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E39 - Epic 39: Epic Zero
1.plot: A time-controlling Matroid and a familiar opponent leads to a battle where Alata is thrown back to before the destruction of Heaven's Tower and the formation of the Goseiger team!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E40 - Epic 40: Strong Alata
1.plot: While the Goseigers deal with an onslaught from Robogog in the present, Alata must unite the three tribes to show their common bond to defeat Bakutofūji-ER in the past.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E41 - Epic 41: Exploding Bonds of Friendship!
1.plot: Eri takes in an abandoned Matroid which she tries to teach the concepts of friendship to, even with Metal Alice's true purpose for it.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E42 - Epic 42: Passionate Hyde
1.plot: Datas is abducted by Metal Alice for further Matrintis study, pushing Hyde into trying to get him back.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E43 - Epic 43: The Empire's General Attack
1.plot: When Robogog announces his final campaign for conquering Earth, the Goseiger respond in facing Matrintis' forces, even with the unexpected moves and sacrifices needed to do so!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E44 - Epic 44: The Ultimate Final Battle
1.plot: The Goseiger launch a final assault on Robogog to prevent Matrintis from conquering Earth; but the confrontation leads to a final twist and an unexpected conclusion!

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E45 - Epic 45: The Messiah is Born
1.plot: The Goseiger go over all their known knowledge of Buredoran in order to figure out who he really is as he prepares to begin his own ultimate plans for conquering Earth.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E46 - Epic 46: Gosei Knight is Targeted
1.plot: Brajira targets his former Headder Gosei Knight in order to force him to work for him again; while Agri and Moune must use their siblings abilities to defeat a threat that keeps healing itself.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E47 - Epic 47: The Trap of the Earth Salvation Plan
1.plot: Hyde takes offense at Brajira treating his Headders, including the now brainwashed Gosei Knight, as tools instead of as partners to work together with.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E48 - Epic 48: The Fighting Gosei Power
1.plot: As Eri takes care of Nozomu, Alata and the other Goseiger try to handle Dark Gosei Knight, believing that he is the final key required for Brajira's Nega-End ceremony.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E49 - Epic 49: Fight Towards the Future
1.plot: Brajira begins the ceremony for his ultimate destruction and recreation of Earth, forcing the Goseiger to face him in one final showdown to prevent everything they protect from being lost.

1.title: FR - Tensou Sentai Goseiger - S01E50 - Epic 50: Protecting the Planet is an Angel's Duty
1.plot: The Goseiger fight to prevent Brajira's final destruction of Earth in order to finish their apprenticeship and prove themselves as true guardian Gosei Angels protecting the planet and all life upon it.

meta.plot: Caitlin "Cat" Sullivan is an NYPD detective working in Brooklyn. After her driving privileges are suspended, she relies on Leo Romba, a highly skilled Brooklyn cab driver from France. Leo becomes Cat's driver and a consultant on her cases. While solving crimes with Leo, Cat is also running her own unauthorized investigation into the death of her father, an NYPD detective thought to have been executed by the Capella crime family. In doing so, she clashes with her boss, Captain Baker, and her ex-husband Gregg, who has picked up the case for the FBI.

1.plot: Daniel's on the hunt for a Boatman Token, which may bring him one step closer to the Gryphon's Egg... if he can find the right item to trade for it.
