meta.plot: Noel is the grandson of legendary Seeker Overdeath and dreams of surpassing his strength. But it turns out that Noel is nothing but a Talker, the weakest class of them all. Undeterred, he uses his silver tongue to gather allies, develop cunning strategies, and form the greatest clan around. Now, as the most notorious Talker, Noel will do whatever it takes to claim supremacy.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Why the Weakest Aims to be the Strongest
1.plot: Noel is a boy who aims to become the strongest Seeker, but the class he is assessed as is Talker, the weakest of them all. As he fights alongside his party, Blue Beyond, he is limited to barking out orders--not directly participating in battle.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - This Talker Is Ruthless
1.plot: Noel and Walter must come up with a plan to capture the runaway Lloyd and Tanya, and get their money back.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Real Deal
1.plot: Blue Beyond is reborn, but it won't get anywhere with Noel as its only member. So he puts out a call for new recruits, only to find an unexpected taker.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - An Apology Won't Cut It
1.plot: Noel and Alma head out on their first job, a request from a poor village chief to deal with a group of thieves giving them problems, but it doesn't go as hoped.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Swordsman from the Far East
1.plot: Noel and Alma are back in Etria, and they decided to spend the day doing some much-needed shopping. However, their date runs into a few roadblocks on the way…

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Price of Honor
1.plot: Noel is having trouble finding new party members that meet his standards, but things take a dangerous turn when someone comes looking for him instead.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - World Without Honor or Humanity
1.plot: After the scuffle, Noel decides to go into action to get his payback on the man who ordered his assassination, Albert Gambino.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Makings of a Champion
1.plot: With Finocchio as witness, Noel has to face off against the representative of Albert Gaminbo's choosing, who happens to be a familiar face.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Snake Sharpens Its Fangs
1.plot: Blue Beyond meets with the Inspector who will oversee their clan application, Harold Jenkins, who explains to them that the situation has changed.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Haves and the Have-Nots
1.plot: Noel sets his sights on the Winged Knights, who decide to take a step forward themselves.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Price of Being Right
1.plot: Blue Beyond and the Winged Knights face off, and Noel has a plan to deal with the skill gap.

1.title: EN - The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Snake Has Wings
1.plot: As the test comes to an end, Blue Beyond and the Winged Knights must come to terms with the aftermath.

meta.plot: Uryu Kamihate is a high school student hoping to enroll in Kyoto University’s medical school. After being taken in by the chief priest at Amagami Shrine, he is told he must marry one of three maiden sisters—Yae, Yuna, or Asahi—to live at, and one day inherit, the Amagami Shrine. Kamihate will need to sweep one of the maidens off her feet in this story of romance, friendship, and fun.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Miracle Begins
1.plot: A young man begins a new life at Amagami shrine, and meets the three sisters who live there.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - String Cranes at Midday
1.plot: The sisters plot to drive Uryu away by making him do all the chores.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Tryst with the Gods
1.plot: Uryu has marriage meetings with all three of the sisters.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Amagami Shrine Festival ~Connections~
1.plot: The sisters are forced to get 5,000 people to come to their upcoming festival, or they'll have to sell the shrine.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Amagami Shrine Festival ~Blossoming~
1.plot: Trouble strikes on the day of the festival! Will enough people come to save the shrine?

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - From Dawn till Dusk
1.plot: Uryu reflects on what happened after the shrine festival, and Asahi offers to help find the answer to his question.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Dream and Moon and Dream ~New Moon~
1.plot: The sisters seek help from the priestess who trained them, but are met with an unexpected demand.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Dream and Moon and Dream ~Half Moon~
1.plot: Yae wonders about her future, while Asahi thinks of moving away.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Dream and Moon and Dream ~Full Moon~
1.plot: The girls give Yomiko the answer, and Uryu promises to support their dreams.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Changing Clothes, Changing Hearts
1.plot: With spring break over, Uryu unexpectedly finds himself at the same school as Yuna.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Prelude~
1.plot: As the sisters and Uryu go out for a late-night trip, Uryu wonders about something strange he found...

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Connections~
1.plot: The sisters, Makoto, and Uryu arrive at Inari Shrine, where Uryu has a strange experience.

1.title: EN - Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Love~
1.plot: Uryu remembers how he first met Yae, and Yae makes a big decision.

meta.plot: The rowdiest guild in Fiore Kingdom is back! Natsu, Lucy, Gray, Erza, and the whole Fairy Tail guild tackle the legendary "100 Years Quest," tougher than any S-Class quest. Their goal: find the first wizard guild ever, located in the far north of Guiltina. Facing new gods, mysterious towns, and ominous foes, they’ll have their work cut out for them. Will they succeed where no wizard has before?

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The "First" Guild and the "Strongest" Guild
1.plot: Natsu and friends visit the very first Wizard Guild to take a quest that no one has ever completed: the "100 Years Quest." Meanwhile, new recruits join Fairy Tail, but one of them is a little odder than usual...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Sea of Dragons
1.plot: The town of Ermina turns out to be a city for fish, where the whole town is submerged in water during high tide. The moment the party mentions Water God Dragon, the fish turn hostile.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Blade, Armor, Ash
1.plot: Dragon Eaters are after Mercphobia to gain the power of Water God Dragon. Natsu and the others join in the battle to aid him, but the foes are strong. Meanwhile, Gajeel, Juvia, and Lily investigate Touka despite the protest from Levy.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Dyed White
1.plot: Natsu, Wendy, and Erza are captured by the Diabolos, and Lucy sets out to go rescue them. On her way, she meets someone unexpected… Meanwhile, Jellal finds out the secret of Touka.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Bitter Choice
1.plot: Natsu and the others manage to drive away the Diabolos for now. Then Mercphobia starts to destroy Ermina and its people, which forces Natsu and his friends to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, the White Mage sets out to do what she came to do…

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Lineage of Fire
1.plot: When Mercphobia goes out of control and almost takes out Natsu, a hand shows up to save him. And it belongs to someone Natsu didn't expect: The Fire Dragon God and the son of Igneel, Ignia.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - All's Well That Ends Well
1.plot: As a thank-you for saving Ermina, Mercphobia gives the group information on the rest of the Five Dragon Gods. And while they're in the town of Tekka, they encounter someone who looks exactly like Erza...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Aldoron, the Wood Dragon God
1.plot: The group is headed to Drasil to find Aldoron. Juvia joins, but she is acting strange and warns the group about the White Mage. Drasil turns out to be a town built on Aldoron, and a kind old man shows them around town. But then...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Whiteout
1.plot: Touka the White Mage brainwashed the Fairy Tail members. She plans to destroy the orbs of the five towns on Aldoron to defeat him; Natsu and the other must fight their friends to save them from the White Mage and stop her plan.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - New Foes
1.plot: Natsu, Lucy, Gray, and Erza fight their own Guild friends to free them from the hypnosis. Then, Wendy encounters a new Dragon Eater. And another Dragon Eater Natsu meets turns out to be...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Wraith, the Spirit Dragon
1.plot: Natsu fights Wraith, the Spirit Dragon, but Natsu's attacks are useless against him. On the verge of death, Natsu sees Zeref, Mavis, and Igneel. As a thoughtform, Natsu is finally able to attack Wraith. That's when Wraith finds a body to possess...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Card in the Hand
1.plot: It turns out that Wraith used to be a Fairy Tail wizard, and Makarov and Wraith were a guild family. Meanwhile, Wendy struggles against Nebaru, and Lucy starts collecting the other Fairy Tail members with the help of Cana and her Magic Cards.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Scarlet Showdown
1.plot: Natsu and Happy find out that Touka is actually a cat, and she has mistaken Happy as Natsu. Meanwhile, Laxus unleashes his new skill, Red Lightning, against Erza. Now it's down to two orbs, but when Happy throws an orb at the White Mage...

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Clinging Dragon Berserk
1.plot: The outcomes of the battles are being decided... While Lucy and the others continue trying to enclose their comrades within the cards, Wendy faces off against the sticky dragon Nebaru, who wants to devour her!

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Howling Earth
1.plot: When all five orbs are broken, something unexpected happens: The Wood Dragon God, Aldoron, is revived. It also activates God Seeds, who start attacking Natsu and the others by becoming the person who they consider to be the strongest.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - God Seeds
1.plot: Natsu turns Wolfen into a fake Zeref and uses Ankhseram's curse on Wolfen. Other Fairy Tail wizards face three other God Seeds: Metro, Gears, and Doom. Then, the leader of God Seeds, Aldoron, shows up in front of Natsu

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Strength to Live
1.plot: Gray and Juvia take on Metro's main body, while the others fight his golems. In the meantime, Jellal takes on Gears. When it's down to Aldoron himself, an unexpected yet familiar face shows up: Brandish.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Burning Will
1.plot: Gajeel turns into a giant by Brandish's magic and fights the Wood Dragon God. Now all that's left to defeat is the God Seed Aldoron. Natsu's fire burns Aldoron, who has no respect for human lives as he regards them only as his food.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Aqua Aera
1.plot: White Mage uses Aqua Aera, Touka's spell, to take Fairy Tail wizards to Elentear, her homeland, but they end up in Edolas. After they get reunited with the Fairy Tail in Edolas, Natsu and the others go to see Mystogan for help.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Selene, the Moon Dragon God
1.plot: The White Mage reveals that her name is Faris and she is from Elentear. She tells the Fairy Tail that she was only doing the Moon Dragon God Selene's bidding to save Elentear. When Selene shows up, she send everyone to Elentear.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - The Moonlight Divinities
1.plot: After Selene transports Natsu and the others to Elentear, they are attacked by her lackeys, the Moonlight Divinities. They fight with the Spirit Arts, which is different from Magic or spells, and the Fairy Tail wizards are in trouble.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Demons' Parade
1.plot: With Aquarius' help, those who have turned into yokai get back to normal. Lucy’s Celestial Spirits all come out to help, and they defeat Yoko. Meanwhile, Touka and Faris meet Suzaku at Whiteout Village.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Sword Saint
1.plot: After Natsu and the others took down Yoko, they meet Suzaku, a Dragon Slayer of Diabolos, who has been summoned from Earthland to defeat Selene. Also known as Sword Saint, Suzaku is a formidable foe and Fairy Tail is helpless against him.

1.title: EN - FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - This Hideous World
1.plot: Gray fights Hakune once again, and his love for Juvia breaks Hakune's attack. Selene reveals to Suzaku that the dragon he ate is her son. Then Wendy finds a connection between tha Hands and the Face of Tartarus.

meta.plot: Takuya and Rika work at the same travel agency in Tokyo and are both happily introverted and single. But their company is opening a new branch in Alaska next year, and employees without a spouse will be recruited to work there. Desperate to avoid the move, and though they’ve hardly spoken before, they decide to fake an engagement. Can these quiet coworkers become a convincing couple?

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Why Don't We Get Married?
1.plot: Takuya and Rika are quiet loners who work at a travel agency in Tokyo. A new branch office is opening in Alaska, and some unlucky unmarried employee will have to run it. Could a fake marriage between two virtual strangers be a way to avoid the transfer?

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - What Does It Mean to Get Married?
1.plot: Someone at work seems to know Takuya and Rika are faking their engagement, so they can't afford to let their guard down at any time. Then, somehow Takuya's father catches wind of the upcoming wedding from all the way across Japan!

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Can We Share Our Predicaments?
1.plot: Takuya plans to go home to Kumamoto over the weekend so he can tell his family the wedding plans aren't real. But first, he has to act as attendant for a high-profile European princess who wants to spend a day touring Tokyo incognito.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Can We Share Our Lives?
1.plot: The plan is for Takuya to fly home and confess about the marriage lie to his family alone, but circumstances force Rika to accompany him. Along the way, the two of them learn more about each other's families and childhoods.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - How About We Travel Together?
1.plot: The trip to Aso largely turns into a comedy of errors, but at least now Takuya's family knows the marriage idea is just a ploy. Afterwards, it begins to resemble a normal countryside trip, but there seems to be no end to the surprises that are in store.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Are Two People Happy Together?
1.plot: After returning to Tokyo, Rika and Takuya are both no longer sure how to communicate with one another. An unexpected turn of events for their coworker Shinshi demonstrates that difficulties can lurk even in the most seemingly blissful of marriages.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Can I Come Over to Your Place?
1.plot: Nao happens upon Rika on her first day in Tokyo. While the two of them are hanging out, Rika expresses frustration over how noncommittal Takuya tends to be, so Nao takes the liberty of ordering Takuya to pay a visit to Rika's apartment.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Are Declarations of Love Genuine?
1.plot: Gonda drops by unannounced and asks for Takuya's help. He's about to meet someone from a dating app in real life for the first time, and he needs a wingman to help ensure things don't go sideways. But it's not exactly a date...

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Rika-san, How Are You?
1.plot: Nao recommends Rika try out glassmaking as a form of stress management. But it isn't long before a stressor from the past reenters Rika's life, and this leads her to take a thorough look at where things now stand between her and Takuya.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Are You Okay With Dating?
1.plot: Rika rather abruptly invites Takuya on a date, and what she has in mind is unconventional to say the least. What's her actual goal for the day, and what happens if things don't play out the way she envisions?

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Are You Serious About Living Under the Same Roof?
1.plot: Kurokawa gives a new work assignment to Rika and Takuya, one that living together for a time would make it easier to complete. But as they soon discover, that would mean having to sort out quite the bevy of details.

1.title: EN - 365 Days to the Wedding [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Are You Really Getting Married?
1.plot: The time has finally come to choose someone for the Alaska transfer. Takuya and Rika might be safe provided everyone believes their fake marriage plan, but once somebody goes in their place, will they be able to live with the guilt?

meta.plot: Tsunehiro’s life isn’t easy. After a doctor gives him two years to live and debt collectors come knocking, he falls from a bridge. In the knick of time, Hana and her crew spot Tsunehiro and pull him to safety. Before returning, they anchor offshore to fish and Tsunehiro catches a huge sea bass in a bout of beginner’s luck. As his apartment building crumbles, Tsunehiro’s new life begins to unfold!

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Negative Angler
1.plot: College student Sasaki Tsunehiro is down in the dumps. After a life of repeated failures, he's been given two years to live. He slips and falls off a bridge as he's chased down by loan sharks.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Fishing at the Pool
1.plot: Hiro returns to his apartment building only to find it being demolished. Takaaki takes him in and presses him into working at Everymart along with his friends. When his new coworkers learn he doesn't like fishing, he gets reeled into fishing again.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Regrets
1.plot: When a huge bounty is put on catching a houndshark, all the anglers rush to be the first to catch it. To their surprise, they find Hiro fishing for the shark in an attempt to pay off some of his debts.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Is Fishing Hard?
1.plot: Hiro settles into working at the Everymart, but quickly finds himself struggling to understand all the fishing equipment he's responsible for selling. Hana steps in to teach him about lures.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Extravagant Angler
1.plot: Hiro gets his first paycheck from Everymart and is immediately dragged to a fishing equipment store, where Hana and Kozue tempt him to make irresponsible financial decisions.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Tai Lover
1.plot: When a customer arrives at Everymart whose language Tsunehiro does not understand, Ice comes to his rescue. As a result, the two get to know each other better, and Ice invites Tsunehiro to go sailing to the open sea with the entire group.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Who Is This Guy?
1.plot: The anglers from Everymart have arranged to go sardine hunting over the weekend. However, Tsunehiro would much rather go fishing for large predatory fish, like he has seen on television.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Family's Relationship, a Child's Growth
1.plot: Machida gets some time with his son on Sunday. He decides to take him out fishing, but his son is an indoorsy gamer who might not be interested.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Hot Pot Party
1.plot: An approaching typhoon has left the Everymart employees stuck inside the convenience store. Since there are no customers, Hiro and his friends have free time to relax. But then the loan sharks who were chasing Hiro show up.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Tsunehiro and Takaaki
1.plot: Machida ends up in the hospital with a skateboard injury. The hospital happens to be the same one Tsunehiro got his diagnosis at.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I Have to Tell Him
1.plot: Takaaki is nowhere to be found, and Tsunehiro is filling in for him at work. The little information provided by Sasaki is fueling the imaginations of the convenience store colleagues.

1.title: EN - Negative Positive Angler [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Negative Positive Angler
1.plot: Takaaki and Hiro run into each other on a bridge, where they had both planned to fish for sea bass. Takaaki is still reluctant to hear what Hiro has to say.

meta.plot: Yoshino’s engagement is far from a dream come true. Her grandfather, head of the largest yakuza group in Kansai, has arranged her marriage to Kirishima, grandson of the Miyama Clan leader, as part of a truce. To Yoshino’s surprise, Kirishima seems kind and charming for a yakuza member. But his warm facade only serves to mask a dark and dangerous truth.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ain't No Place for Losers Here
1.plot: Yoshino, the granddaughter of the local yakuza boss in Osaka, is shocked when she learns that to establish peace between their gangs, she is supposed to become engaged to the grandson of a boss from Tokyo.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Let Me Express My Sincerity, and Maybe Earn Your Affection in the Process
1.plot: The daughter of the president of another subsidiary of the Tokusa group has gone missing, so Yoshino must be accompanied around the clock by Kirishima for her safety.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Triangle From Hell
1.plot: As she and Kirishima try to figure each other out, some visitors from Kansai cast an ominious light on Yoshino's stay in Tokyo.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Is He Smart or Stupid?
1.plot: After a tense encounter between Kirishima and Shouma, Shouma drives back to Osaka. Yoshino gets the sense that something is spoiling Kirishima's mood and confronts him. Like every year, Yoshino catches a summer flu.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Camellia Princess
1.plot:
After their final exams, Yoshino and Kirishima head to Yokohama to meet Yoshino's cousin, Tsubaki Akashigata, who recently moved from Kyoto. Reuniting after a long time, the three—Yoshino, Tsubaki, and Kirishima, who tagged along—explore the city together. They enjoy reminiscing and chatting about trivial things as they stroll through Yokohama. However, their fun is interrupted when Yoshino gets a call from school and has to leave, leaving the other two behind.

Kirishima seizes the moment and invites Tsubaki on a casual date. Alone together, they find themselves inside the glowing Ferris wheel at night. In this private, quiet space, Kirishima turns to Tsubaki and asks her an important question.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I'd Rather Be Hated if You're Indifferent – Part 1
1.plot:
Returning to Japan after living abroad, Nao Shioda lands a job as a TV announcer. She crosses paths with Kirishima, her ex-boyfriend from the past. In front of their friends, the two pretend to be strangers, but when they find themselves alone, Kirishima gently speaks to Nao and hands her his contact information.

Meanwhile, Yoshino and Kirishima travel to Osaka. While there, Yoshino reconnects with Shoma after a long time apart. Coincidentally, Nao also arrives in Osaka to attend an event, setting the stage for their paths to cross once more.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - I'd Rather Be Hated if You're Indifferent – Part 2
1.plot:
From her seat on the bus, Nao spots Kirishima and Yoshino walking together. Unable to ignore them, she gets off at the next stop to follow. However, it's Yoshino who approaches Nao first. The two women begin to talk, and the conversation inevitably turns to their shared connection: Kirishima.

Nao reveals to Yoshino some of Kirishima's past that Yoshino had no idea about. Meanwhile, Nao faces trouble of her own. Her ex-boyfriend, Ozu, has uncovered secrets about her past and her previous relationship with Kirishima, gaining leverage that could impact her future. With this power, Ozu makes a troubling demand of Nao—one that could change everything.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 1
1.plot: The semi-criminal group holding grudges against Yoshino and Kirishima, along with Azami Suou, had gathered under Ozu’s command. While Kirishima was with Nao, Yoshino spotted Ozu and his group and decided to carry out a plan on her own. Upon learning about Yoshino’s situation, Kirishima reluctantly contacted Shoma, the only person he could turn to in Osaka, to entrust Nao to him and head toward Yoshino. During this time, Kirishima called Yoshino, and the two made a significant "bet."

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 2
1.plot:
Kirishima finds himself in the crowded chaos of a fireworks festival, while Yoshino and a group of delinquents gather nearby. Yoshino chases after Oz, who has been abducted by Naoya, while Kirishima blends into the crowd and launches a surprise attack on the delinquents. Targeted due to the incident involving Shiori Akaza, Yoshino is spotted by Naoya and faces imminent danger. Kirishima continues to take down the delinquents one by one, but a mysterious and dangerous figure, Azami Suo, suddenly appears before him.

"Where is Yoshino Somei?" Azami asks Kirishima. But what is Azami's true objective...?

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - If I’m Honest, I Want to Get Married – Part 3
1.plot: Azami's true intentions for searching for Yoshino and the words Minami said to Shoma before leaving remain shrouded in mystery as Azami and the others disappear without a trace. Left behind, Kirishima and Yoshino confront Ozu, who has been captured, demanding he settle Naoya's scandals and promise never to interfere with them again. Despite Ozu's skillful maneuvering, always stopping just short of breaking the law and avoiding creating any vulnerabilities, Kirishima sets a trap for him. With the case resolved, Kirishima earns the right to be Yoshino's boyfriend and enthusiastically presses forward, only for Yoshino to propose a certain challenge to him.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - A Wild Creature You Can't Keep Once it Grows Up
1.plot: After visiting the Somei family grave, Kirishima is invited to the Somei group, where he spends a pleasant time. The group enjoys a barbecue together, sharing stories about young Tsubaki, who looked strikingly similar to Kirishima. Renji, one of Tsubaki's few close friends, reminisces about the past and shares nostalgic tales with Yoshino and Kirishima. However, the atmosphere becomes tense when Hotei returns from work. Summoned to the basement by Renji, Kirishima and Shoma are questioned about the uproar involving semi-outlaw groups that occurred in the Kansai region, a matter that also entangled Yoshino.

1.title: EN - Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - As She Fades, a Dark Night Falls, and the Rain Begins to Pour
1.plot: After a tumultuous visit to her hometown, Yoshino and Kirishima return from Osaka to the Miyama residence in Tokyo. They thought their usual daily life would resume as always, but from the very next day, Yoshino starts ignoring Kirishima. She alters her schedule to avoid him when going to school, ignores him when he speaks, and offers no response even when he cooks for her. A rare moment of distress overtakes Kirishima, who sits in the rain in front of the annex where Yoshino is staying. What is the reason Yoshino continues to ignore Kirishima...?

meta.plot: This young girl hates all those goodie-two-shoes heroines. So when she’s reincarnated as Alicia, the villain in her favorite fantasy dating sim, it’s like a dream come true! There’s just one problem: the more she tries to be evil, the more the prince seems to fall for her. Alicia will have to work much harder if she ever wants to become the world’s greatest villainess.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Villainess and Working Out
1.plot: "Without effort, there's no reward! This applies to aspiring villainesses as well." With that in mind, Alicia wants to train not only her mind but also her body from a young age. Because only then can she ultimately come closer to her ideal.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Kiss With a Witch
1.plot: Believing that actual experience is just as crucial as book smarts if she wants to be the greatest villainess ever, Alicia heads to the village of Loana, which is isolated by a magic barrier. There, she has an encounter that changes her life...

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Villainess and Trespassing
1.plot: Alicia sets off on a major exploration at the magic school. There, she encounters her fiercest rival: the heroine!

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Villainess and the Flower Field
1.plot: Recognizing Alicia's talents, Luke asks her to become the watcher of Liz, who is likely the Saint. Alicia sees it as a chance to become the heroine's rival and agrees. She enters the Academy as a special exception, but finds herself in enemy territory...

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Villainess and the Villainess Test
EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Villainess and Sleeping Side by Side
1.plot: Alicia falls into a trap and ends up in danger. She tries to escape on her own, but the arrival of an unexpected savior leaves her in an entirely new dilemma.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Villainess Sits This One Out
1.plot: Alicia promises her father that she'll meet his condition of getting her magic to level 90 so she can continue to be Liz's watcher. She secludes herself in a tiny shed to train, and all the while, Gill awaits her return.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Villainess and the Return
1.plot: Her training complete, Alicia is now fifteen years old and quite beautiful, and with stronger magic than ever. She immediately heads to the village of Roana and makes a move that shocks everyone...

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Villainess and the Dramatic Chin Lift
1.plot: Alicia is flustered after her knee-jerk reaction to Duke's strong feelings led to her coldly brushing him off. After giving further thought to what Duke means to her, Alicia decides to take action in true villainess style.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Villainess and the Past
1.plot: Will tells Alicia and all the villagers of Roana about his own past, describing the scheme he fell victim to and the regrets it left him with. Then Alicia returns to the academy and quickly becomes tangled up in yet another plot...

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Villainess and the School Idol
1.plot: Alicia becomes interested in the neighboring nation of Laval. In order to be a villainess who goes down in history, she knows she needs to learn more about the world outside the game's script, but it won't be easy...

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Villainess and the Saint
1.plot: Mel's diligent investigation has revealed the Saint's secret, and it plays a big role in the academy's current state of affairs. To guide the Saint down the correct path as her watcher, Alicia the villainess finally confronts Liz the heroine.

1.title: EN - I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Villainess and the Prince
1.plot: Duke coldly asks Alicia, "Who are you?" It seems like someone has cast magic on him that erased his memories of her... and Alicia is the top suspect. What will become of her?

meta.plot: Ten years have passed since the end of Bakumatsu, an era of war that saw the uprising of citizens against the Tokugawa shogunate. The revolutionaries wanted to create a time of peace, and a thriving country free from oppression. The new age of Meiji has come, but peace has not yet been achieved. Swords are banned but people are still murdered in the streets. Orphans of war veterans are left with nowhere to go, while the government seems content to just line their pockets with money.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kenshin - Himura Battosai
1.plot: 11th year of the Meiji Era in downtown Tokyo. Kaoru Kamiya, the acting master of the “Kamiya Kasshin-ryu” style, was chasing after the “Hitokiri Battosai,” who was claiming to be a user of her sword style. One night, Kaoru meets a man carrying a sword. She immediately questions the man, but he seems to have absolutely no will to fight. “Is this the rumored Hitokiri Battosai?” As Kaoru dubiously looks on, the man introduces himself as Kenshin Himura, a “Rurouni.”

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Tokyo Samurai - Yahiko Myojin
1.plot: It's been a week since the resolution of the crossroad killing case, in which the name of the Kamiya Kasshin-ryu was deceptively used. Although the name of Kamiya Dojo has been cleared, there's no sign of an increase in the number of Kaoru's students. Then a passing boy, Yahiko Myojin, pickpockets Kenshin's wallet. Kenshin gives him the wallet, saying that it was his fault for allowing it to get stolen. Yahiko is repulsed at being treated like a child, but he has a reason to collect the money.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Kasshin-ryu - Reborn
1.plot: Yahiko's heart is moved by Kenshin and he decides to quit pickpocketing. Yahiko refuses to pay Kanto Shueigumi and resists their demands, but he is beaten up. Kenshin comes to his rescue and settles the matter. Regretful that he could not solve the problem by himself, Yahiko wishes to become stronger. Seeing this, Kenshin takes Yahiko to the Kamiya Dojo.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Fighter for Hire - Sanosuke Sagara
1.plot: Kenshin, Kaoru, and Yahiko visit Akabeko, a beef hot-pot restaurant, where a group of democratic rights activists gets into a heated argument. One of them throws a bottle of sake, and it hits Kenshin, causing a commotion. Sanosuke Sagara, who happened to be in the store during the quarrel, stood up and blew away the activists with a single flick to the forehead. Seeing Kenshin's strength, Sanosuke's curiosity is roused and he asks, "You wanna buy a fight from me?"

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - And Then, Another
1.plot: Kenshin confronts Sanosuke, who wields the giant Zanbato with ease. However, Sanosuke shows his incredible durability after withstanding a strike from Kenshin with ease. This leads Kenshin to instead launch a barrage of blows at him, and Sanosuke falls to the ground. For a moment it looked as if victory has been decided. However, while Sanosuke is in a daze, he recalls the reason for his obsession with victory, his past from ten years ago when he was in the Sekiho Army...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Kurogasa
1.plot: Kenshin receives a request from the police chief, asking for his help to take down "Kurogasa," a serial killer who has been repeatedly targeting former Revolutionary warriors. Kenshin and Sanosuke go to escort Jusanro Tani, who received a letter containing a death threat. As warned in the letter, at 1:00 a.m. sharp, Kurogasa appears. His true identity was Jine Udo, a vagabond slayer who had made a name for himself in the assassination business since the Bakumatsu Era.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Two Hitokiri
1.plot: Knowing how strong Kenshin was when he was the Hitokiri Battosai, Jine takes Kaoru hostage in order to fuel Kenshin's anger. The two engage in a fierce battle. However, Jine, believing that Kenshin has not yet regained his former strength, inflicts the Nikaido Heiho "Shin no Ippo" on Kaoru, causing her to stop breathing. With only two minutes until Kaoru dies of asphyxiation - Kenshin's anger reaches its peak.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Beauty on the Run
1.plot: Sanosuke's friend has died from an opium overdose. However, Kenshin and Sanosuke are perplexed at how he even got his hands on the drug, since opium is banned and too expensive for the average person to afford. Then a mysterious woman, Megumi Takani, appears before them. Kenshin and the others fight off Kanryu Takeda's private army who is trying to capture Megumi. However, Megumi is carrying opium...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Oniwabanshu Strike
1.plot: Hyottoko, a member of the Oniwaban group, raids Kamiya Dojo, where Megumi is hiding. He unleashes his special attack "Fire Breath," in which he breathes fire from his mouth, onto Kenshin and Sanosuke. Anticipating the defeat of Kenshin and the others at the appearance of the powerful middle-ranked spy, Megumi tries to flee the scene, but Kaoru stops her and says "He's fighting for you," telling her to believe in Kenshin's strength.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Reason to Act
1.plot: The pursuers from the Oniwaban Group haven't made an appearance for over a week, and during this time Megumi familiarized herself with the Kamiya Dojo group. Sanosuke, however, was still unsettled and feeling frustrated knowing that Megumi was the one who made the opium that caused his friend's death. Then one day, Megumi suddenly disappears. In a letter they found from her, it stated that she had left of her own volition, but Kenshin and the others found this to be unnatural. They decide to head to Kanryu Takeda's residence, the man who was sending spies after her.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Savage Han'nya - Honorable Shikijo
1.plot: Kenshin, Sanosuke, and Yahiko scramble to take back Megumi from the Kanryu residence. They are confronted by Han'nya, a spy of the Oniwaban Group. He trifles Kenshin with his martial arts skills and his "Arm-extension Spell", but Kenshin successfully conquers him when he uncovers the secret of the technique during the fight. Just when it looked like the battle was up, Han'nya removes his mask and reveals his startling true face.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Okashira - Aoshi Shinomori
1.plot: At last, Kenshin faces off against Aoshi Shinomori, the head of the Oniwaban Group. In the Bakumatsu Era, the battle-obsessed "Oniwaban group" lost their meaning of existence after surrendering the castle they served without even being able to fight. Aoshi is unable to bear this regret and is in earnest pursuit of the title of the strongest warrior. As a former Revolutionary warrior, Kenshin cannot tolerate conflict without morality. Two men who made killing their profession in the Bakumatsu Era clash against one another, putting their pride on the line.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Battle's End
1.plot: In order to kill Kenshin, Kanryu uses his Gatling gun and rains a flurry of bullets at him, uncaring that the Oniwaban Group that was under his command would also be hit by this attack. In the face of this evil act, the Oniwaban Group make full use of their individual abilities to counter the Gatling gun. At this moment, theirs and Kenshin's purpose become one. Kenshin and the Oniwaban group team up to challenge the overwhelming power of a modern weapon.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Yahiko's Battle
1.plot: Yahiko, the sole student of the Kamiya Dojo, has started to step away from his training from time to time. He says he's merely going on a walk, but it is clear that he takes his swordsmanship training very seriously, and it doesn’t look like he's ditching to slack off. Curious about what he's doing, Kenshin, Kaoru, and Sanosuke decide to follow him. What exactly is Yahiko's reason for ditching?

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - That Man - Raijuta
1.plot: Kaoru, Kenshin, and Yahiko visit Maekawa Dojo for a training session. The dojo is very lively, and Kaoru's training is well-received by the students of other sword styles. Then a swordsman named Isurugi Raijuta breaks in. He says he is concerned about the future of sword art, and the man, carrying only an actual sword, dismisses the idea of a bamboo sword match. In order to defeat the challenger, Maekawa, the master of Maekawa Dojo, takes on Raijuta, but...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Ideal Man
1.plot: Raijuta, who wants to revive the murderous sword, considers Kenshin, who denies his idea, as an enemy. Raijuta initiates a fight using his actual sword, but Kenshin lands a blow that breaks Raijuta's sword and stops the situation from escalating further. After some time has passed, Yutaro, a boy who claims to be Raijuta's apprentice, arrives at the Kamiya Dojo. He claims he has come to challenge Yahiko, with whom he doesn't get along, to a match, but the way Yutaro holds his bamboo sword is no good...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Settling the Score
1.plot:
Yutaro sustains a heavy injury from Raijuta's sword, and it is so severe that he will never be able to swing a sword with that arm ever again. Although Yahiko was constantly disagreeing with Yutaro until now, he understood very well what swordsmanship meant to him. He takes Yutaro's hand and leads him out of the medical room, so they could witness the final battle between Kenshin and Raijuta.

Deep in the night on a woodland path, Kenshin and Raijuta's duel begins.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Sanosuke & Nishiki Paintings
1.plot: Sanosuke is visiting the sukiyaki restaurant Akabeko, where he always leaves his bill on a tab. One of Akabeko's workers, Tae, asks him to go buy a Nishiki painting from the painting shop on her behalf. Though Sanosuke had no interest in paintings, he finds one at the store that catches his eye. It was a painting of the man he looked up to as his master back when he was a member of the Sekiho Army, Captain Sagara. With a gleam in his eyes, Sanosuke makes his way to meet with the artist of the painting.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Tsunan & Nishiki Paintings
1.plot: Tsunan is seeking to clear his decade-old unresolved regrets surrounding the Sekiho Army. Empathizing with him, Sanosuke joins Tsunan in conspiring an attack on the Home Ministry. However, Kenshin was waiting for them inside the building to stop them. Seeing the former Revolutionary warrior standing in their way, the same way they faced off against Revolutionary warriors when they were in the Sekiho Army, Tsunan's fighting spirit burns. A flurry of explosives are hurled at Kenshin.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Meiji Swordsman Romantic Story, Act Zero (1)
1.plot: Kenshin and the group are enjoying some tea time together. The group probes Kenshin to entertain them with an interesting story from his travels, specifically requesting "a story that's unusual, fun, and includes a villain's defeat." To answer to their demands, Kenshin decides to tell them about someone he met when he was visiting a foreign settlement in the lively city of Yokohama. A foreign doctor named Elder who was always wearing a mask.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Meiji Swordsman Romantic Story, Act Zero (2)
1.plot: The current Kenshin has left his past as a manslayer and wished for a peaceful world. Though Elder looked at him with eyes of confusion, Kenshin knew that Elder also shared this same desire for a healthy society and felt a sense of comradery with him. Meanwhile, another doctor called Deian Ishizu was scheming to get rid of Elder, as Elder did not seek monetary gain in exchange for her medical services, and Deian thought this was disrupting his business. Deian hires Espiral, a master of Western swordsmanship, to get rid of Elder. However, it seems Espiral has an entirely different motive for taking on the job...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Resurrection of the Wolf
1.plot: Kenshin sees a dream recalling the Shinsengumi, who he faced off against back when he was a Revolutionary warrior. The Shinsengumi was a group of highly skilled swordsmen who he fought on equal footing back when he was the Hitokiri Battosai. He feels unsettled and ponders why he is suddenly remembering them. As the tension persists, a mysterious man with very unique-looking eyes pays a visit to the Kamiya Dojo while Kenshin, Kaoru, and Yahiko are not home. When he meets Sanosuke, who just happened to be at the Dojo, he claims that he is Goro Fujita, a medicine seller, but...

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Wolf's Fangs
1.plot: After defeating Arundo Akamatsu, Kenshin returns to the Kamiya Dojo and sees Hajime Saito. Hajime had introduced himself to Kaoru and Yahiko as Goro Fujita, the police officer, and they had invited him into the Dojo without any suspicion. Hajime criticizes Kenshin and the others for their naivety. Over the past ten years that Kenshin had washed his hands of manslaying, Hajime had honed his killing intent and skills as a hitman, and now Hajime's ferocity was aimed at them.

1.title: EN - Rurouni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Meiji 11, May 14th
1.plot: The person who had sent Hajime to face Kenshin was none other than the Head of the Home Ministry, former Satsuma Domain Revolutionary warrior, Toshimichi Okubo. He asks Kenshin to go to Kyoto to stop the secret plans of a man who claims to be the legitimate successor of the Hitokiri Battosai. However, that man was supposed to have been killed 10 years ago by his own comrades in the government, as they regarded him as a threat. Receiving this request to conduct an assassination, what will Kenshin's answer be...?

meta.plot: Natsume Takashi has the ability to see spirits, which he has long kept secret. However, once he inherits a strange book that belonged to his deceased grandmother, Reiko, he discovers the reason why spirits surround him.

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Cat and the Book of Friends
1.plot: Natsume discovers that the heirloom "Book of Friends" that his grandmother, Reiko, gave him possesses the names of the spirits she defeated and bound to her will. Assisted by a cat whom Natsume addresses as Nyanko-Sensei (lit. Master Little Meow), Natsume aims to return all of the names to their rightful owners.

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Dew God's Small Shrine
1.plot: Natsume is visited by the village's local god who is currently fading because of the lack of devotees.

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Mysterious Person at the Eight Fields
1.plot: Natsume is implored to help spirits who are currently being exorcised. He finds a kindred spirit in Tanuma, a boy who also senses spirits although not as powerful as Natsume.

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Shigure and the Girl
1.plot: Natsume's secret is found out by Sasada, the class president, during the "Trial of Courage." She asks for his help to find the spirit that lives in the abandoned school. Natsume denies the fact that he can see anything, but she won't take no for an answer. Meanwhile, the spirit, Shigure, captures the rest of their school mates, in fury of the school being torn down...

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Heart-Colored Ticket
1.plot: Natsume comes across an old ticket in Reiko's belongings and decides to go to the abandoned train station to see why she kept it. There, he meets a slow witted spirit named Santo, who was waiting for Reiko the entire time to go Kiriganuma, to see and make up with his friend, Mikuri, but the trip isn't as easy as it first seems...

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Swallow at the Lake Bottom
1.plot: Natsume goes to a dam and finds a town that had been submerged in water. Just then, Natsume gets possessed by a yokai and falls unconscious.

1.title: EN - Natsume Yujin-cho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Little Fox's Hat
1.plot: Natsume goes to a hot spring for a school trip, with an errand from Shigeru to pick up teacups from a near by pottery. While there he meets and helps a little fox spirit, who quickly grows attached to him.

meta.plot: Humans and katawara are at war, but there are those on each side who join forces. Tama is a fox spirit who loves humans, while her sendou brother, Jinka, despises them. Together, they use the power of spirit transformation to defeat the monstrous katawara and put an end to the evils of this chaotic age. What destiny awaits the duo at the end of their journey?

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - We Are Those Who Lament This Barbaric Age
1.plot: Shinsuke plans to attack a local group of brigands, only to be beaten to the punch by the eccentric Tama and Jinka. Impressed by their prowess in battle, Shinsuke becomes determined to follow them, and offers to take them to the brigands' leader.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Shakugan
1.plot: The party retreats after failing to defeat the rampaging katawara. The monks in their party are shocked when they learn exactly who taught Jinka the secret of spirit transformation. Shinsuke, in turn, is shocked to learn the katawara's true origins.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Year Seven of the Eiroku Period
1.plot: Jinka pours his fury out on the Dangaisyuu temple, prompting the local leaders to discuss moving operations elsewhere. Meanwhile, Tama tells Shinsuke and Shakugan a little more about herself and Jinka's spirit transformation.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Jinka and Humans
1.plot: Shinsuke and Shakugan are staying with Jinka and Tama, but Shinsuke isn't learning much in the way of fighting skills. Instead, Shinsuke is left behind to do chores when Tama and Jinka are informed of trouble with a local katawara.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Higan
1.plot: Shinsuke starts training with Zanzou, who's recuperating in a mountain cave and requests payment in the form of food. Zanzou tells Shinsuke about his sister, and how she came to join the Dangaisyuu as a nun.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Fukou
1.plot: Raidou departs the party, but not without giving Shinsuke a surprising gift first. The journey to Kagan's home is long, and the others are exhausted when they cross paths with a group of monkey katawara.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Kagan & Shakuyaku
1.plot: The party finally reaches Kagan's hometown, a settlement of katawara. Coincidentally, a pregnant human arrives at the same time, seeking shelter so she can give birth. Not coincidentally, some Dangaisyuu agents also arrive...

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Mystic Swordsman
EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Mountain Goddess (1)
1.plot: Jinka, Tama, and Shinsuke meet with the Mountain Goddess to discuss their next course of action against the Dangaisyuu, while Jinun and Senya continue to hunt for them.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Mountain Goddess (2)
EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Strongest of the Dangaisyuu
EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Jinka & Douren, Takekichi & Barry
1.plot: Battles unfold in parallel with Jinka and Shinsuke taking on Douren and Resshin. But even if they succeed, how can they take down Taizan, who's been turned into a walking fortress?

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Godbeast
1.plot: Jinka squares off for the final battle against Yazen, but as the two spiritually transformed humans fight, Jinka treads into dangerous territory.

1.title: EN - Sengoku Youko Senma Konto Hen [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 -

meta.plot: Old schoolmates Haru and Gaku will do anything to achieve success. And success to them means earning a trillion dollars! But to do so, they’ll need to take full advantage of their own unique skills. Haru is a persuasive and confident speaker who can connect with anyone, while Gaku, although awkward, is an expert programmer. Will their combined talents be enough to make their dream a reality?

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The World's Most Selfish Man
1.plot: Gaku possesses outstanding computer skills but is socially awkward. Haru's only talent is talking. After graduating from university, Haru wants to use Gaku's abilities to fulfill his childhood dream—to earn a trillion dollars.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - START UP
1.plot: After Haru blows their entire startup capital on an expensive office chair, the two young entrepreneurs set out to find a generous investor. There's only one problem: They haven't achieved anything, nor do they have any idea for their business model.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - You'll Win, Won't You?
1.plot: Kirika offers to invest in Haru and Gaku for a 51% shareholding ratio, which would give her control over their company. Haru uses her offer as a weapon and enters a hacking tournament in order to attract other investors.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Bad Guy
1.plot: The preliminary phase of the Security Championship is nearing its conclusion. Will Haru and Gaku manage to secure a spot among the top 12 teams and reach the finals?

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Maiden's Gaze
1.plot: Haru and Gaku compete as the only second team in the final round of the Security Championship. But right from the start, Haru demonstrates that he can contribute to the duo's victory even without IT skills.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Want You To the Moon
1.plot: Gaku and Haru win the Security Championship, but they're disqualified after a complaint over their physical attack against the other competitors. However, investor Kedoin Kazuki is drawn to their abilities and reaches out to them.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Trillion Game, Inc
1.plot: With the name of the company settled, Haru and Gaku move on to hiring personnel. But which of the five applicants would be most suited to the job, especially when it hasn't been decided what the "job" is yet?

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Flowers and Splendor
1.plot: The trio is trying to launch an online shop where customers receive advice from a seemingly AI that appears as a VTuber avatar. Soon, they also discover which market they can specialize in.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Flower Way of Kabuki
1.plot: Haru and Gaku begin working as hosts in Shinjuku's Kabukicho to better understand their target market.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - GOLDEN EGG
1.plot: Haru and Gaku's AI specialty shop catches the attention of Dragon Bank, who uses their media empire to bring them down. Not one to be beaten, Haru immediately begins preparing a counterattack.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Illusory Man
1.plot: Trillion Game, Inc. invites investors to a private information session for their new social game project, which includes an appearance from a surprising guest.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Two Bad Guys
1.plot: Haru and Kedoin visit God Promotion, Kedoin's former employer, to make a deal.

1.title: EN - TRILLION GAME [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Episode 13

meta.plot: À peine la formation terminée, les Limandes, une équipe de sauveteurs juniors, s'installent à la plage pour des aventures riches en sensations fortes, et en bonne humeur.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E01 - Fresh Off the Bus
1.plot: A summer of fun begins as the Flounders take control of Tower 2. But Brody’s bad attitude inspires a risky plan -- and a radical transformation.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E02 - Escape from Party Beach
1.plot: After Garvin blames the Flounders for bad buzz, Tyler and the team prepare for a dazzling reputation reboot.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E03 - The Splash and the Furious
1.plot: The Flounders gear up for action-packed adventure when Junior Rescue receives new equipment. Elsewhere, Eric and Lizzie grow closer.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E04 - Sand and Deliver
1.plot: As Junior Rescue celebrates Family Day, Lizzie attempts to hide a secret, Dylan pursues a new passion, and Tyler faces his toughest critic.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E05 - Stranger Flings
1.plot: Things take a tender turn as Eric unpacks his feelings. Meanwhile, Gina encounters a new rival, and Dylan opens up to Tyler.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E06 - With a Little Kelp from My Friends
1.plot: Mystery and mischief collide as the boys partake in a super-secret project, and the girls team up for a sticky situation.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E07 - Pier Pressure
1.plot: As the sun begins to set on Junior Rescue season, a staff shake-up leads to a new normal -- and a "special assignment" -- for the Flounders.

1.title: FR - Malibu Rescue: The Series - S01E08 - Every Rose Has Its Thornton
1.plot: Dylan, Lizzie, Gina, Eric and Tyler bid farewell to summer with one last mission: to foil Thornton's devious plans.

meta.plot: Résolus à mater un complot pour suivre et contrôler les enfants, et déterminés à sauver leur monde, les jumeaux Dru et Kal s'allient avec une bande de fugueurs rebelles.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Dru avoids a school dental check-up by persuading his twin brother Kal to go in his place. While celebrating Diwali, they notice Kal's new abilities. Could they be linked to a warning from recently disappeared classmate Tim?

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: During a fitness test, Dru struggles to keep up with his classmates. The twins look into Infinity Group, the organization behind the dental check-up, which leads them to a mysterious group of unnamed kids.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: From their tunnel hideout, the unnamed kids debate whether to meet with the twins. Meanwhile, Kal threatens to expose his double implant when he displays super strength during a kabaddi match, umpired by his Dadi.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Having made contact with the tunnel kids, or the Unlisted, Dru and Kal attempt to piece together what they know about the Global Child Initiative and Infinity Group. But they are interrupted by a medical emergency.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Tim returns to school, but he is behaving strangely. Discovery of the tunnel puts the Unlisted in jeopardy, and the twins have to decide whether they can trust their Bua when she accepts a job with the GCI.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Kymara makes a mistake that places the other Unlisted in danger. The twins face increased scrutiny following a new arrival at the Sharma house, Chinese exchange student Jiao.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Jiao earns the twin's trust when he helps them out of a sticky situation, but his intervention rouses the suspicion of class bully Regan. A field trip to GCI headquarters sees the boys entering the lion's den.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Horrified by what has happened to Jiao, the twins team up with Bua to bring down Infinity Group from the inside. But as the GCI takeover continues at school, the boys are barely able to maintain their cover.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Rose and Gemma make plans to meet with another Unlisted kid, Mack. At school, the new caste system stirs resentment among some of the students, and Kal begins to enjoy his Elite status a little too much.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Captured, Rose and Mack come face-to-face with Infinity Group CEO Emma Ainsworth. On a rescue mission, the other Unlisted enlist the help of Dru, who is no longer certain that he can trust Kal.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: As Infinity Group's hunt for missing children ramps up, the Unlisted make themselves at home in the Sharma house. Dadi becomes a powerful ally when she stumbles across the kids. But Kal's behavior grows increasingly erratic.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: When they discover the true purpose of the Global Child Congress, the Unlisted hatch a plan to take down the GCI mainframe. Kal's strange behavior forces Dru to make a painful decision.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: The Unlisted attempt to bring down the mainframe at HQ, but walk into a trap. Under complete mind control, Kal becomes an Infinity stooge, and sets out to track Dru down.

1.title: FR - Les Anonymes - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: The Unlisted and Dru make a last-ditch attempt to bring down Infinity Group. Emma Ainsworth introduces Kal to the world, and makes a surprising discovery that threatens to derail the organization's sinister plan. Series finale.

1.title: FR - The Victim - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A trial begins: on one side a grieving mother and on the other a man accused online of being her son’s killer. But who is the accused and who is the victim?

1.title: FR - The Victim - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Craig prepares for his day in court as threats against him and his family escalate and Rebecca’s doubts about her husband take root. Is he telling her the whole truth?

1.title: FR - The Victim - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As Anna takes the stand, the strain of the trial threatens to destroy her family. Her search for proof of Eddie J Turner’s identity continues, but what will she do if she gets it?

1.title: FR - The Victim - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The jury returns its verdict and Anna discovers her fate in court. Craig and Anna are brought face to face once more as part of the judicial process, and shocking new evelations come to light.

meta.plot: Quinze ans après le meurtre de son jeune fils par un enfant de 13 ans, Anna Dean milite pour que la nouvelle identité du meurtrier soit rendue publique.
The Dorados, Culiacan's local team, are at the bottom of the rankings when Maradona arrives, looking for a fresh start. The experts predict disaster.

1.title: EN - Maradona in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dreams
1.plot: The Dorados supporters are thrilled with Maradona's coaching. Suddenly, Dorados look like contenders, an unlikely prospect just a year ago.

1.title: EN - Maradona in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - An Unlikely Home
1.plot: A reporter compares Maradona's Culiacán gig with his heroic work in Naples. The team can use the inspiration in the face of its latest challenge.

1.title: EN - Maradona in Mexico [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - One Last Push
1.plot: Against all odds, Maradona gets Dorados to the final again to face an old foe. Will the team make the leap to Liga MX?

1.plot: Danny and Brett must discover whether or not Gold Napoleon coins are the originals, or replicas as a coin dealer claims them to be.
