1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E05 - Powerswitch
1.plot: When the Judge tricks Brett and Danny into identifying a dead woman found floating in the waters of the French Riviera, they end up investigating an international stock swindle.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E06 - The Time and the Place
1.plot: Danny runs into political intrigue when he discovers the dead body of a reporter, then can't find it until it turns up in a car crash hours later.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E07 - Someone Like Me
1.plot: After Brett loses seven days, Danny thinks Brett is acting strange but Brett thinks someone is impersonating him. They both can't be right.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E08 - Anyone Can Play
1.plot: Danny has to go on the run from enemy agents after his gambling winnings at a Brighton casino turn out to be part of a communist plot to pay off spies when they use the right code words.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E09 - The Old, the New and the Deadly
1.plot: It seems that everyone including a former Nazi wants a German Eagle statuette, and they think that Danny is the one who has it.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E10 - Angie... Angie
1.plot: An childhood friend of Danny's from the Bronx turns out to be a hit man hired to kill an American labor leader on holiday at the Cannes Film Festival.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E11 - Chain of Events
1.plot: While out camping at Brett's family estate, Danny gets chained to a brief case which he can't get off that contains a bomb.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E12 - That's Me Over There
1.plot: In order to catch a war criminal, Danny must impersonate the kidnapped Brett, but how will he explain an English Lord with a Brooklyn accent?

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E13 - The Long Goodbye
1.plot: When Danny and Brett find the decade-old dead body of a scientist in a crashed plane in the Scottish Highlands, several women claiming to be his daughter offer them various inducements to part with the formula they found.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E14 - The Man in the Middle
1.plot: When Brett's plan to capture a traitorous British spy by pretending to be him results in his own capture, Danny enlists the aid of one of Brett's relatives to rescue him.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E15 - Element of Risk
1.plot: At a London airport, a gang of crooks who are planning a bullion heist mistake Danny for a criminal mastermind when the man's suitcase accidentally ends up in Danny's luggage cart.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E16 - A Home of One's Own
1.plot: Danny buys a `handy man's special' cottage in England and discovers that his neighbors are into the occult.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E17 - Five Miles to Midnight
1.plot: Trying to open a travel business, Danny and Brett encounter a New York hoodlum who needs to be smuggled out of Italy after he killed an Italian gangster.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E18 - Nuisance Value
1.plot: After Danny is accused of kidnapping his blind date, a rich man's spoiled daughter, Brett and Danny decide to help rescue her from the real kidnappers but have problems keeping her rescued.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E19 - The Morning After
1.plot: Brett wakes up one morning and discovers that he got married the night before.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E20 - Read and Destroy
1.plot: Seeking sanctuary with his old friend Brett is a spy who plans to publish his memoirs, which contain the name of every NATO, SEATO, and ANZUS agent.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E21 - A Death in the Family
1.plot: Brett's relatives are being killed off one by one, so Brett and Danny decide to find the killer before he gets to Brett.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E22 - The Ozerov Inheritance
1.plot: To retain the family jewels, an elderly Russian duchess must present proof of her marriage into the Russian Royal Family, which  she says she can do with the help of a journal kept by one of Brett's uncles.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E23 - To the Death, Baby
1.plot: Brett and Danny both end up wooing an heiress after they are asked to break up a romance between a her and a gigolo who is courting her.

1.title: FR - Amicalement vôtre - S01E24 - Someone Waiting
1.plot: Brett resumes race car driving, only to become the target of someone who is willing to kill him in order to make him stop.

meta.plot: Lord Brett Sinclair, un aristocrate britannique, et Danny Wilde, un riche self-made-man américain, n'ont rien en commun, si ce n'est leur fortune, leur goût pour les femmes et leurs fonctions secrètes au service de la justice. Tous deux aident en effet le juge Fulton, un magistrat en retraite, à appréhender les bandits ayant échappé à la justice. Avec pour seules armes leurs poings et leur sens de l'humour, Brett et Danny finissent par intervenir dans toute l'Europe, de préférence sous le soleil de la Côte d'Azur ou dans les meilleurs palaces du continent, où pullulent margoulins, maîtres-chanteurs et espions.

Six childhood friends make a vow one day to become treasure hunters, and eventually grow to be the strongest heroes in the world. During his first quest, Krai Andrey realizes he isn’t cut out for the job. Even so, his friends make him their leader. Underpowered in the face of great expectations, Krai embarks on a reluctant hero’s tale of glory, headaches, and wanting to retire early.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Today, I Just Want to Go Home
1.plot: Krai Andrey is the master of the clan named First Steps. Although he would prefer to retire, he can't find an opportunity or the right time to do so. Krai explains in detail how he ended up in this situation.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Want to Leave It to Tino and Take It Easy
1.plot: Tino has received a mission from Krai. But before she can set out, she needs a few strong members for her group. Greg, Rhuda, and Gilbert are already ready.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I Want to Fly Straight Through the Sky
1.plot: Tino and her group are fighting against a phantom even before they enter the treasure chamber. In the process, they realize that their opponent is significantly stronger than level 3. Meanwhile, Krai rushes to them to save them from their terrible fate.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Mysterious Mask Wants to Fight
1.plot: Krai and Tino's group wander through the White Wolf's building. The group believes that Krai knows where the exit is located. However, he is clueless. Then, they suddenly encounter the survivors they were trying to rescue.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - I Want to Leave Everything to Ark
1.plot: A long time ago, Sitri entrusted Krai with one of her alchemy creations: a slime powerful enough to destroy all of Zebrudia. When Krai discovers the slime is missing, he scrambles to recover it before chaos ensues.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Want to Sleep Instead of Taking Charge
1.plot: The Akashic Tower decides on an all out war against the hunters because they falsely believe that Krai found their facility. Independent of that, Krai's careless words cause a huge group of hunters to be sent to the White Wolf's Den.

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Akashic Tower Wants to Experiment
1.plot: Sitri is finally back, but instead of focusing on the slime, she gives Krai an ominous warning. That at this rate, the entire investigation team will perish. The lethal battle between hunters and the Akashic Tower has been kicked off!

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Want to Rush In When It's Over
1.plot: Sitri saves the day. Flustered, the Akashic Tower's members ignore Sophia's orders and self-destruct. As Sitri has figured out their headquarters, the hunters press on. Flick uses his lightning spell on them all, and for a moment it seems it's all over...

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Want to Teach Love and Peace
1.plot: The hunters are faced with chimeras and a giant golem. The intense battle suddenly comes to an end when Krai arrives. The next day Noctus and the other members of the Akashic Tower are finally reunited with Sophia. But she is acting strange, and then a certain someone appears...

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - I Want to Be Renowned in the Capital
1.plot: The Dragon Slayer Arnold Hail is level 7 and he proudly rolls into the capital with his party "Falling Fog", but Krai doesn't even show a shred of interest. Meanwhile, getting his relics charged is causing quite commotion...

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Falling Fog Wants Revenge
1.plot: The Falling Fog came to the capital to make a name for themselves, instead they get disgraced. To regain their honor, Arnold sets his sights on Krai, but he is preoccupied with how to repay his immense debt to Sitri. When chance brings them together, a fierce battle unfolds...

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - If Possible, I'd Like to Get It
1.plot: Krai discovers an exceptional relic that'll soon go to the auction. Since he really wants it, he contacts the seller directly. But that turns out to be Arnold, and Krai's clumsy negotiation skill backfires completely. Others people then butt in and the relic goes to the auction anyway...

1.title: EN - Let This Grieving Soul Retire [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - I Want to Win the Bid No Matter What
1.plot: The auction has finally begun. Cry has racked up a huge amount of debt in order to bid on the one Noble Phantasm he was looking for, but his eyes are drawn to the many Noble Phantasms on the stage and his feelings are disturbed. As Cry's reason and patience reach their limits, what is brought into the venue is the Akasha Golem that Sitri wanted. Cry, who understood Sitori's feelings, gives up on the Noble Phantasm he was aiming for and goes into a big fight, throwing everything away to win the golem bid. An auction that brings together a variety of thoughts. How will it end?

meta.plot:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
1.plot: A group of pirates lead by Alvida plunder a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a mission to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Coby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro
1.plot: Luffy and Coby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Morgan VS Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?
1.plot: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Coby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Luffy's Past! The Red-haired Shanks appears
1.plot: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!
1.plot: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs Luffy!
1.plot: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Grand Duel! Zoro the Swordsman vs Cabaji the Acrobat!
1.plot: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Who Will Win? Showdown Between the True Powers of the Devil!
1.plot: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

1.title: EN - One Piece Log Fish Man Island Saga [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
1.plot: Nami form an alliance becoming the navigator of the crew, but not a full member yet. They arrive in Syrup Village looking for a suitable ship. On this island they know the liar Usopp, who also has ties to the Shanx.

meta.plot: Ars Louvent is reincarnated in another world as the young son of a minor noble who owns a small domain. Ars is not particularly strong or intelligent, but he was born with the Appraisal Skill that's able to see others' abilities and statuses. He uses his skill to find the best hidden talents in the world to make their small, weak domain into the best.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Reincarnation and Appraisal
1.plot: Three-year-old Ars Louvent has the power to visualize the innate talents of others. One day he meets Rietz, a man of an undesirable social class but with incredible talents, only Ars can see. Can he overcome prejudice to take him into his retinue?

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Above and Below
1.plot: To prepare for the political turmoil ahead, Ars is now determined to recruit the most talented people he can find with the help of his Appraisal skill, and he's off to a larger town to see if he can scout someone with an aptitude for magic.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Answer
1.plot: Ars has discovered someone with an extraordinary talent for magic, just as he'd hoped. The hitch is that she has no interest whatsoever in serving him. Can Ars win her over, much less help her out of the terrible predicament she's in?

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Where Talent Dwells
1.plot: Ars's quest to recruit more talent continues into the future, especially as his family grows and tensions begin mounting. Little does he know he may find it in the most unexpected places, or rather, the most unexpected people.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Storm Arrives!
1.plot: Things are looking grim around the Louvent estate as the political situation continues to deteriorate, but nothing could prepare Ars for the storm that's about to blow in—the fiancée he didn't know he had!

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Face of a Warrior
1.plot: Raven's condition takes a turn for the worse as the worst comes to pass politically. The governor has been assassinated, meaning the local lords must now brace for war. Can Ars lead House Louvent in his ailing father's stead?

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Succession
1.plot: Raven returns from the most recent campaign in dire shape. At the doctor's behest, House Louvent braces itself for a great loss. Thankfully, with Ars to succeed his father, not all hope is lost.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A New Generation
1.plot: Ars has big shoes to fill as he takes over for his father as the new lord of House Louvent. With the trusty band of retainers he's built up over the years, is he up to the task?

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Sounding Out
1.plot: Now that the governor is dead, his sons are in a deadlock over who will succeed him. Lord Lumeire's league has chosen their side, but one local district remains a political holdout—and Ars is determined to figure out why.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Couran Salamakhia
1.plot: Ars receives a personal invitation to a party hosted by Couran Salamakhia, the elder of the late governor's two sons. Ars hardly knows what to make of the situation, much less the big ideas Couran is about to share with him.

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Mireille Grangeon
1.plot: Mireille is making a real impression at House Louvent... and it's not a good one. Ars believes in her potential, however, leaving him at a crossroads when the complaints start coming in about her. Thankfully, Mireille has an unconventional solution!

1.title: EN - As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Oath
1.plot: The mock battle to decide Mierille's fate and the future of House Louvent is on!

meta.plot: Jill Savelle—fiancée of the crown prince Gerald de Kleitos and known as the "Lady Goddess of War"—is being hunted down by the same country she swore to protect. Betrayed by her betrothed, she is framed as a traitor and imprisoned. In her last moments, Jill is filled with regret, but just as death approaches, she awakens six years in the past. This time, she will not be a mere pawn. Now as a 10-year-old girl, Jill resolves to escape her imminent engagement to the prince. To this end, she jokingly professes her love to the 19-year-old dragon emperor Hades Theos Rave, who will one day stain the land in blood due to madness. But against all expectations, he accepts! In contrast to the tyrant from Jill's memories, the Hades of this time is a kind albeit unfortunate emperor. Can Jill prevent Hades from descending down the same dark, villainous road, or is he bound to an inevitable future?

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Tried to Avoid the Route to Destruction and Somehow Ended Up Courting My Greatest Enemy
1.plot: Betrayed by her fiancé, Jill's life nearly ends in frustration, but instead, she suddenly finds herself back on the night she was proposed to six years ago. To avoid the route that leads to her doom, she makes use of a man that crosses her path, but...

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Already Know the Tragedy That Is to Come, so I Will Do What I Can to Avoid It
1.plot: Hadis accepts Jill's proposal and gifts her the Dragon Consort's ring. After suffering a sudden enemy attack, they arrive in Beilburg. There, Sphere, a candidate to become Hadis's fiancée, and daughter of the local lord, comes running up to the ship.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Situation Is Desperate, but as the God of War’s Daughter, I Will Defeat the Enemy with Brute Strength
1.plot: With the combined information from the other captives, Jill sees through the Marquess Beil's plot. Realizing that she must act quickly, and knowing that the others may not trust her, she takes a chance and asks for help. Will it be enough?

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - My Fiancé Is Trying His Best to Woo Me and I Don’t Know What to Do about It
1.plot: Hadis must deal with Marquess Beil and his men. Will knowing Jill's wishes make a difference? And for Jill, hearing the heartless words the marquess hurls at Hadis makes her worry that Hadis pushes himself too hard.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - When Seeking the Truth, Things Turned into an Argument, so I Can No Longer Do Anything
1.plot: Prince Gerald goes to Beilburg to see if it's true that Jill was abducted. To deny the rumors, Hadis and Jill must show that they're happy, but it may not be so easy. Then their meeting with Gerald is cut short by distressing news of Marquess Beil.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Upstarts Are Attempting to Get Close to My Fiancé and I Want to Beat Them at Their Own Game
1.plot: Hadis' enemies are conspiring against him. Jill has secretly worked out a plan to protect him, but she's locked inside a barrier and Rave won't let her out. Instead, he tells her the real reason she was chosen as the Dragon Consort.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - I Want to Stop Living the Slow Life, so I Have Decided to Start in the Dragon Knights
1.plot: Hadis, Jill, and the others head to the imperial capital, Rahelm. As they near the city, they're suddenly attacked! Jill and the others spring into action. Amidst the fighting, the leader of the other forces accuses Hadis of being a false emperor.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I, the Dragon Consort, Am Now Hated by the Dragon and I Want to Find a Way to Be Friendly Again
1.plot: Jill has been accepted into the Dragon Knights, but during an aptitude test referred to as dragon initiation, Captain Elentzia's dragon does something unexpected and the test is cut short. Jill heads home feeling useless... until Hadis talks to her.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - My Fiancé and I Nearly Ripped Each Other to Shreds and It May Still End up Being a Bloodbath
1.plot: Risteard brings Hadis to Elentzia. Jill encourages Hadis to talk to them, which leads to a shocking development. In the midst of their negotiations, a dragon knight enters with news that a force has arrived to burn down the town!

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - As a Result of Doing-over My Life, I Find Myself Out of Options Once Again
1.plot: At the castle, Elentzia asks Jill to look after her little brothers. The party leaves, hoping to meet up with reinforcements, but wary of a trap. Jill reminds herself that she's there to make sure Hadis never feels alone.

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - My Fiancé’s Uncle Is Behaving So Outrageously That I Can No Longer Stand Silently By
1.plot: Hadis has been betrayed. An unexpected intervention allows Jill to escape certain death, but drops her into another dire situation. Jill finds herself face to face with an angry dragon, and her powers are still sealed away!

1.title: EN - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor
1.plot: The truth of the Rave imperial family is revealed. Hadis explodes with rage. His expression, twisted with hate and despair, is exactly the same as that of the Hadis Jill knows from the future. Will she be able to save him this time?

meta.plot: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Here's Ranma
1.plot: Soun Tendo gets quite a surprise when the son of his friend Genma Saotome that he's arranged for one of his daughters to marry turns out to be a girl...

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - School is No Place for Horsing Around
1.plot: Attending his first day at Furinkan High, Ranma encounters Akane's many would-be suitors.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Sudden Storm of Love
1.plot: Not realizing that Ranma and 'the pigtailed girl' are the same, Kuno is furious that he let the "cretin" slip away. His attention soon shifts to the red-haired one though, when she bests him in combat.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Ranma and... Ranma? If It's Not One Thing, It's Another
1.plot: As Kuno continues his attempts to get a date with the 'pigtailed goddess', Ranma starts freaking out, while Nabiki smells money.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Love Me to the Bone! The Compound Fracture of Akane's Heart
1.plot: A solid beating from Akane brings Ranma to Dr. Tofu, who tries to help out the two teens' relationship, as well as Ranma's injuries.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Akane's Lost Love... These Things Happen, You Know
1.plot: Akane and Ranma are back at Dr. Tofu's when Kasumi shows up, causing Tofu to start acting like a loon out of love, something Akane doesn't handle well.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Enter Ryoga! The Eternal 'Lost Boy'
1.plot: After years of searching, Ryoga Hibiki finally finds the person who ruined his life - Ranma Saotome. Now, if only Ranma could remember what the heck he did to make Ryoga so mad...

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - School is a Battlefield! Ranma vs. Ryoga
1.plot: Ryoga finally manages to find Ranma again, and challenges him to a fight in the schoolyard. Unfortunately for Ranma, several outside parties have a vested interest in seeing him lose.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - True Confessions! A Girl's Hair is Her Life!
1.plot: Akane's accidental haircut brings a temporary reprieve in Ranma and Ryoga's fighting. Stunned, she wanders off alone, thinking about the loss of the one thing that wasn't 'tomboyish' about her.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - P-P-P-Chan! He's Good For Nothin'
1.plot: Not knowing that it's Ryoga, Akane adopts the little black pig as her pet, naming him P-Chan. This of course drives Ranma crazy, as he desperately wants to get Ryoga away from her, yet feels honorbound not to reveal the secret.

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Ranma Meets Love Head-On! Enter the Delinquent Juvenile Gymnast!
1.plot: Intending to insure St. Hebereke School for Girls' victory in the upcoming match, Kodachi of puts the entire Furinkan Martial Arts Rythmic Gymnastics team out of commission. Akane is chosen as Furinkan's replacement, but not only does her gymnastics skills leave something to be desired, Kodachi decides to lessen Akane's odds with a little visit to the Tendo Dojo...

1.title: EN - Ranma ½ [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Woman's Love is War! The Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics Challenge!
1.plot: Akane twists her ankle during practice, forcing Ranma to take her place in the match with Kodachi.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E01 - I Need Light
1.plot: A young woman is discovered brutally murdered in the fashion of Jack the Ripper. Chief Inspector Frederick Abberline believes The Ripper has returned, but Reid, the new head of the precinct, believes a different kind of evil may be at work.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E02 - In My Protection
1.plot: When a toy-maker is murdered, a 14-year-old boy is the suspect but Reid digs deeper and discovers a vicious child gang and its brutal master. Jackson's gambling may expose his American past.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E03 - The King Came Calling
1.plot: Deliberate contamination is suspected in a sudden cholera outbreak . Emily's search for a charity patron proves difficult.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E04 - The Good of This City
1.plot: The brutal clearing of a local slum for the underground railway reveals an almost indecipherable murder scene and an unreliable slum girl witness. Lucy Eames, beautiful and disturbed, is the unlikely key to a Byzantine web of conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E05 - The Weight of One Man's Heart
1.plot: A string of brilliantly masterminded robberies keeps Reid and his team busy and leads to a blast from the past for Drake when he is confronted by his former army colonel. As the net closes in on the robbers, the sergeant finds his loyalties put to the test.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E06 - Tournament of Shadows
1.plot: As the dock strike of August '89 takes hold of the city, the killing of a Jewish anarchist leads Reid and the team into the heartless chicanery of the British government's fight against distant empires and global terrorism.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E07 - A Man of My Company
1.plot: International haulage tycoon TP Swift arrives in town to acquire an ailing shipping line, accompanied by a team of private detectives, who proceed to cut a violent swathe through the borough on a mission of vengeance. As Reid focuses on the murder of an engine inventor, Jackson and Susan's past comes back to haunt them, bringing their future in Whitechapel - and their very lives - into question.

1.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S01E08 - What Use Our Work?
1.plot: Reid is adrift, his team in pieces and Leman Street shaken to its foundations following recent events. A kidnapping offers him cause to assemble his men and tackle the white slavery ring operating in their midst. But Reid is gripped by a growing obsession that this leads back to the terrible secret from his own past.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E01 - Pure as the Driven
2.plot: Jack the Ripper may be fading into memory, but east London has found no peace. An investigation into the assault of a policeman leads DI Reid and the men of H-Division to the newly-emergent Chinatown, where Jackson discovers evidence of a new and devastatingly powerful opiate. Reid fears a new kind of hell is to be released onto his streets.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E03 - Become Man
2.plot: The abduction of a prominent member of the London County Council introduces Reid to Councilor Jane Cobden, the first woman appointed to the LCC - because it appears the kidnappers are radical supporters of Cobden's aims. Long Susan is taken by force to the gang's hideout, and she soon finds herself growing sympathetic to her captors' lives and aims.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E04 - Dynamite and a Woman
2.plot: An Irish bomber is sprung from prison and barely a day later a prominent opponent of the Home Rule movement is murdered. Chief Inspector Abberline is convinced that the Irish Republican Brotherhood is active once more and orders Reid to send the Irish DC Flight undercover into Whitechapel's Irish community.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E05 - Threads of Silk and Gold
2.plot: An investigation into the brutal murder of a Telegraph Boy reveal a vice racket being run from the offices of the GPO. A ledger leads Reid to the centre of the one of London’s most august financial institutions, Barings Bank.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E06 - A Stronger Loving World
2.plot: Churches and synagogues are being burnt and desecrated in Whitechapel and Reid suspects the same hand behind the various attacks. Meanwhile, the all-too-brief domestic happiness that Sergeant Drake has enjoyed is disrupted by the arrival of a friend from his wife Bella's past, the mysterious and charismatic scholar, Gabriel Cain.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E07 - Our Betrayal (1)
2.plot: A valuable symbol of the British Empire’s wealth shows up in the form of an uncut diamond. It is a jewel ‘freed’ from the diamond monopoly of De Graal by one Daniel Judge, Captain Jackson’s untrustworthy older brother. Reid and Flight find themselves being drawn to the plight of a local craftsman defrauded of his work and income by a scam that is set to return H Division to the malign influence of Detective Inspector Jedediah Shine.

2.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S02E08 - Our Betrayal (2)
2.plot: Death and violence comes to Whitechapel once again. Some decayed and murdered bodies are discovered in a slum tenement, and the advanced stages of the police divisional boxing championship reveals the vengeful ferocity to be seen within the ranks of the police force.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E01 - Whitechapel Terminus
3.plot: Reid and Long Susan are set on a collision course after a locomotive disaster.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E02 - The Beating of Her Wings
3.plot: A murder inquiry in a curiosity shop reveals a secret dungeon and signs of a captive girl.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E03 - Ashes and Diamonds
3.plot: Alex le Shayne, a mysterious clairvoyant is found dead at the local performance place. Jackson presumes poison has a part to play. As Reid is missing Drake steps in to investigate. Elsewhere Susan continues to care for Mathilda and plans to send her to Switzerland.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E04 - Your Father, My Friend
3.plot: Ghosts of Whitechapel's past come alive, setting our heroes on a path of destruction.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E05 - Heavy Boots
3.plot: A destructive gang of youths unleash hell upon the streets, but it's not until daylight breaks that the true horror of their brutal work is revealed. The trail leads the team of H Division into the heartland of one of the city's oldest trades - the London Breweries - where conflicted loyalties reign, and grief and anger create a potent concoction.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E06 - The Incontrovertible Truth
3.plot: The recovering Reid finds the unconscious Lady Vera Montacute in Whitechapel next to the corpse of a flower seller.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E07 - Live Free, Live True
3.plot: The murder of a chemist lifts the lid on a backstreet abortion racket.

3.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S03E08 - The Peace of Edmund Reid
3.plot: When an American journalist is killed in Whitechapel, his story threatens the peace.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E01 - The Strangers' Home
4.plot: Reid must return to Whitechapel to covertly re-investigate a case made by Drake and Jackson.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E02 - Some Conscience Lost
4.plot: Reid struggles to adapt on his first day back at H Division under Drake’s command.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E03 - A White World Made Red
4.plot: Jackson feels the heat when a double murder throws light upon his recent illicit activities.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E04 - Men of Iron, Men of Smoke
4.plot: When a footballer is brutally murdered, a key suspect is a man close to Drake's heart.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E05 - No Wolves in Whitechapel
4.plot: Drake's life unravels as he questions whether he sent an innocent man to the gallows.

4.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S04E06 - Edmund Reid Did This
4.plot: The walls close in on Reid as a secret from his past threatens to destroy his future in Whitechapel.

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E01 - Closed Casket
5.plot: Reid - on the run from the police - must find a way to bring down Assistant Commissioner Augustus Dove.

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E02 - A Brittle Thread
5.plot: Reid and Dove engage the press in their battle for the hearts and minds of the people of Whitechapel.

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E03 - All The Glittering Blades
5.plot: The serial killer - Nathaniel Dove - is hid in the Hackney Marshes, but how long can he stay out of trouble?

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E04 - The Dreaming Dead
5.plot: Thatcher discovers a fresh lead of a double murder committed by Nathaniel, giving Reid cause for hope.

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E05 - A Last Good Act
5.plot: With Reid locked in the cells it seems that all hope is lost, but is there time for one last roll of the dice?

5.title: FR - Ripper Street (VOSTFR) - S05E06 - Occurrence Reports
5.plot: Reid must finally bring Augustus Dove to justice, but also find his peace in Whitechapel.

meta.plot: A drama set in the East End of London in 1889, during the aftermath of the "Ripper" murders. The action centres around the notorious H Division – the police precinct from hell – which is charged with keeping order in the chaotic streets of Whitechapel. Ripper Street explores the lives of characters trying to recover from the Ripper's legacy, from crimes that have not only irretrievably altered their lives, but the very fabric of their city. At the drama's heart our detectives try to bring a little light into the dark world they inhabit.

1.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S01E01 - The Fledgling
1.plot: Diplomat Sir Hallam Holland moves into the iconic townhouse along with his wife, Lady Agnes. With the help of former parlormaid Rose Buck, they launch a whole new era for the sumptuous home at the heart of Upstairs Downstairs.

1.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S01E02 - The Ladybird
1.plot: With no sign of a thaw in relations between Lady Agnes and Maud, Hallam finds his diplomatic skills put to the test at home as well as at work. The servants are intrigued by a mysterious new addition to the household, while a restless Lady Persie embarks on a dangerous flirtation, and is drawn to the thrill of radical politics.

1.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S01E03 - The Cuckoo
1.plot: Sir Hallam finds himself at the centre of a national crisis when his friend, the Duke of Kent, asks for help. Meanwhile, storm clouds are gathering within 165 Eaton Place, with Lady Agnes's growing fear over the imminent arrival of her baby, and the servants' concern for Lotte, who refuses to speak. But, as the king finally abdicates, Hallam makes a discovery that will change his life forever.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E01 - A Faraway Country About Which We Know Nothing
2.plot: As 165 Eaton Place reopens its doors, two new arrivals make their mark. But whilst Sir Hallam's forthright aunt Blanche disrupts life upstairs, feisty new maid Beryl struggles to adjust to life in service. Meanwhile, Lady Agnes' concern for her children reveals a dark secret about Mr Pritchard. Sir Hallam's preoccupation with burgeoning Nazi Germany leads him into dangerous waters, and a chance meeting with an unexpected face unlocks a hidden desire within.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E02 - The Love That Pays the Price
2.plot: Lady Agnes catches the eye of charismatic American millionaire Caspar Landry but, as she and Sir Hallam look to their future, a tragic turn of events leaves their promised dreams - and a close family member - in jeopardy. Downstairs, Mrs Thackeray makes a momentous decision, which throws the running of the house into chaos. Blanche and Mr Amanjit continue to clash, until a heart-breaking cause compels them to reconsider their differences.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E03 - A Perfect Specimen of Womanhood
2.plot: Blanche comes face to face with her former lover when a scandalous novel is published and, when the passion between the pair reignites, begins to consider a life away from Eaton Place. Downstairs, Beryl's decision to take a stand causes serious ructions to the running of the house until a familiar face offers wise words. Meanwhile, when Lady Persie reveals a shocking secret to Sir Hallam, the pair get ever closer as Persie is forced to make a life changing decision about her future.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E04 - All the Things You Are
2.plot: Harry, deemed too old to participate in a local boxing championship, takes Johnny under his wing to teach him the ropes. With Lady Agnes being drawn to the charms of Caspar Landry and Sir Hallam's growing infatuation with Lady Persie, this once happy couple seems to be drifting further apart, much to the pleasure of Lady Persie who seems to be getting far too much enjoyment from the conquest of her sister's husband. Mr. Amanjit finds himself a target of racial discrimination.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E05 - The Last Waltz
2.plot: As 165 Eaton Place prepares for the Annual Servants' Ball, Mr Pritchard enjoys a romance with fellow servant Miss Whisset, and starts to wonder if there is more to life than service. With war looming, Harry has a proposition for Beryl, however, a shocking revelation threatens to thwart their plans. Meanwhile, as Lady Persie and Sir Hallam continue their torrid affair, Sir Hallam is about to discover just how destructive his actions have been.

2.title: FR - Maîtres et Valets - S02E06 - Somewhere Over the Rainbow
2.plot: On the eve of war, Beryl and Harry face a race against time to get married. Meanwhile, Mr Pritchard makes a decision which throws the running of the house into chaos, until an old face lends a helping hand. And as Lady Agnes returns to London, a dark discovery has explosive consequences for all inside Eaton Place and changes their lives forever.

meta.plot: Londres, 1936. Le 165 Eaton Place, abandonné depuis le départ des Bellamy 6 ans auparavant, reprend vie grâce à l'arrivée des nouveaux propriétaires : Sir Hallam Holland, diplomate de haut-rang et sa femme Lady Agnès. Pour redonner tout son lustre à cette somptueuse demeure, Lady Agnès consulte Rose Buck, l'ancienne gouvernante des Bellamy, pour qu'elle recrute le personnel adéquat...

Arrivé par hasard dans la ville de Two Rivers, Butch décide d’y réunir ses frères pour braquer ensemble un convoi d’or afin d’aider leur mère à reconstruire sa ferme qui a récemment brûlé. De son côté, Jack devient rapidement le Shérif de la ville et séduit la fille du Maire, la charmante Lisbeth, tandis que Cole tombe sous le charme de la “patronne” du saloon, la très étrange Miss Daisy. Peu à peu, les trois frères se réconcilient, s’intègrent et apprennent à devenir de vrais hors-la-loi en espérant monter le plan parfait pour leur futur braquage. Mais le temps presse ; ils ne disposent que de quelques semaines et les habitants de Two Rivers ne sont pas aussi honnêtes qu’ils en ont l’air...

FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E01 - Presidio
1.plot: Millie Harcourt and Jean McBrian travel to San Francisco and join forces with two American codebreakers to pursue a serial killer from their war days.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E02 - Wake
1.plot: The search for the killer terrorising the Fillmore district continues. Millie, Jean, Iris and Hailey are under pressure to work out who the killer is so they can stop them before they strike again.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E03 - Charlotte's Web
1.plot: As Iris struggles with husband Marcus’ imminent deployment overseas, she and the other women delve into the mysterious death of a friend - and uncover a marriage built on lies and deception.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E04 - Madhouse
1.plot: After a seemingly innocent man is charged with murder, the women become involved in a tangled suburban tragedy, racing to find both the true killer and the methods before the scent goes cold. Meanwhile, Jean grapples with how to build a new life for herself.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E05 - Not Cricket
1.plot: A bloodied and battered stranger collapses on Millie and Jean's doorstep, dragging them into a mysterious criminal underworld.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E06 - Iron in War
1.plot: Having uncovered a covert system of police corruption, the women must go it alone, crafting a complex sting operation in order to draw out two warring factions and see justice done.

1.title: FR - Enquêtes codées : San Francisco - S01E08 - In for a Pound
1.plot: A death in the Big Bop Club brings an international incident right to their doorstep, while the women grapple with Jean's sudden disappearance.

meta.plot: Deux détectives britanniques et leurs homologues américaines utilisent leur talent en cryptologie et leur intelligence inouïe pour enquêter sur différents meurtres.

À Weimar, la jeune Dörte découvre avec effroi et délices l'aventure artistique du Bauhaus, fondé par Walter Gropius. Cette série alerte et romanesque retrace les débuts de l'école, son ouverture ambivalente aux femmes et ses méthodes d'enseignement révolutionnaires.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E01 - After the War
1.plot: Eager students arrive at the Bauhaus art school in Weimar.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E02 - The Prince of Thebes
1.plot: Master Itten introduces students to his exercise and dietary regime.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E03 - The March Dead
1.plot: A military coup threatening Germany comes to Weimar.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E04 - The Women's Course
1.plot: Gropius invites certain students to help him create the Sommerfeld House.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E05 - Court of Honor
1.plot: Walter's relationship with Dörte gives rise to rumours and allegations.

1.title: FR - Bauhaus : Un temps nouveau - S01E06 - The End at Weimar
1.plot: The survival of the Bauhaus rests on the success of their exhibition showcase.

meta.plot: Un crime violent a été commis dans une clinique psychiatrique. La victime, Ana, une jeune femme de 28 ans avait été internée contre son gré et devait sortir le lendemain du soir où elle a été assassinée. On l’a retrouvée étouffée et… le cœur arraché. Angèle, jeune et brillante inspectrice de police est chargée de l’enquête. A-t-elle affaire au crime d’un fou ou à celui d’un « normopathe » parfaitement lucide qui s’applique à le faire passer pour l’acte d’un dément ?

1.title: FR - À l'intérieur - S01E01 - À Agnès D.
1.plot: Ana is found dead, her heart torn out, just before she was to leave the psychiatric hospital where she had been sectioned. A first investigation for Angèle Maury, one she'll have to conduct alone. But how to question the mentally ill? Can they be believed? Was the murderer a patient?

1.title: FR - À l'intérieur - S01E02 - Ariane
1.plot: Angèle discovers a worrying detail: she and Ana were both born in the same year and on same day. The autopsy reveals that Ana had had consensual sexual relations before her death. Another patient in the clinic is pregnant but has absolutely no memory of having had sex. Coincidence?

1.title: FR - À l'intérieur - S01E03 - Maxime
1.plot: Angèle hopes to find answers in Ana's personal diary, but most of it is illegible. The patients are very disturbed and fear a new tragedy. As Ana continuously appears to her, Angèle is disconcerted by Simon, a schizophrenic patient who is also terribly seductive.

1.title: FR - À l'intérieur - S01E04 - Rose
1.plot: Maxime is in a coma, knocked out as he was about to reveal the murderer's name. Only Rose, the clairvoyant, can now help Angèle but she has isolated herself and refuses all contact. Obsessed by Ana, fascinated by Simon, Angèle is slipping gently "to the other side".

1.title: FR - À l'intérieur - S01E05 - Simon
1.plot: Maxime comes out of the coma and reveals the murderer's name to Angèle. Shocked by the revelation, she decides to say nothing, convinced that he's lying. Meanwhile, those around Angèle question her lucidity. Commissioner Favard, having discovered that she had hidden the truth from him, takes her off the case.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In a small town in Vosges, one remaining factory keeps people afloat. But when the managers announce a redundancy plan, everything crumbles.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Things get increasingly complicated for Martel. Rita takes her brother Greg in after a breakup. Bruce gets involved in a dangerous deal.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Martel and Bruce attempt to carry out an abduction, but it ends in a fiasco when the young woman escapes and finds her way to Rita.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While seeing his mother, Martel learns that the Benbareks have also paid a visit. Vélocia's management files a complaint against Rita.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Rita lies in hospital after an attack at her home. Things are no better for Martel, especially when a tragic event adds to his growing problems.

1.title: FR - Aux Animaux la guerre - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: While living with Martel, Rita questions what she knows about him and finds a damning photo. Alone again, Martel can no longer contain his rage.

meta.plot: Championne des causes perdues, chargée de trouver un accord de fermeture d’usine dans les Vosges, l’inspectrice du travail Rita sait qu’elle ne sauvera au mieux que quelques salariés sur la centaine laissée sur le carreau. Un soir, les phares de sa vieille voiture éclairent une jeune fille courant à demi nue… Deux ouvriers désespérés - deux pauvres types comme Martel, le syndicaliste qui planque ses tatouages, et Bruce, le bodybuilder sous stéroïdes - ont eu la mauvaise idée de kidnapper une fille sur les trottoirs de Strasbourg pour la revendre à deux caïds qui font la pluie et le beau temps entre Épinal et Nancy.
Dans ce docu-série, la légende du foot Diego Maradona vole au secours de l'équipe locale de Culiacán, fief d'El Chapo. Peut-être se sauvera-t-il lui-même dans la foulée.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E01 - Arrival
1.plot: Dorados, Culiacán's local team, are at the bottom of the table when Maradona arrives, looking for a fresh start. Experts predict disaster.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E02 - One Of Us
1.plot: Maradona is generous and warm towards his players. Many, like him, come from poor families. But the passionate coach also has a temper.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E03 - Dreams
1.plot: The Dorados supporters are thrilled with Maradona's coaching. Suddenly, Dorados look like contenders, an unlikely prospect just a year ago.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E04 - Bitter Rivals
1.plot: Dorados are on the verge of gaining promotion to Liga MX when Maradona blows his top at the referees. Still, hope reigns, and the team keeps fighting.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E05 - Nightmares
1.plot: At the start of a new season, Maradona checks into a clinic in Buenos Aires, leaving the team on its own. Rumors swirl and the team grows anxious.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E06 - An Unlikely Home
1.plot: A reporter compares Maradona's Culiacán gig with his heroic work in Naples. The team can use the inspiration in the face of its latest challenge.

1.title: FR - Maradona in Mexico - S01E07 - One Last Push
1.plot: Against all odds, Maradona gets Dorados to the final again to face an old foe. Will the team make the leap to Liga MX?

meta.plot: Quand une unité de renseignements polonaise découvre qu'un attentat se prépare grâce à une arme de l'arsenal soviétique, un agent est envoyé enquêter. Mais celui-ci ne s'attend pas à découvrir que les hautes sphères de l'état polonais sont elles-mêmes impliquées.

Adaptée des romans de Chris Ryan, cette mini série suit les aventures des forces spéciales anglaises en 2003, au Moyen-Orient, lors de guerre d'Irak.  La section 20 du MI-6 déploie ses moyens pour combattre le terrorisme. Les agents de terrain les plus efficaces parcourent le globe pour éradiquer les menaces.

1.title: FR - Strike Back - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Still haunted by the memory of a disastrous Special Forces mission which he led in 2003, John Porter is given an opportunity to redeem himself by returning to Iraq to rescue a kidnapped TV reporter.

1.title: FR - Strike Back - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: After locating the terrorist safe house Katie is being held in, Porter is also taken prisoner, and Hugh Collinson and a team at Section 20 have to act quickly before it is too late.

1.title: FR - Strike Back - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Collinson sends Porter undercover to Zimbabwe on a mission to break a former British soldier who was involved in a political assassination out of a high-security Harare jail.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: British sergeant Michael Stonebridge recruits help from Ex-Delta Force operative Damien Scott when an agent named John Porter is kidnapped by a Pakistani terrorist. The two then uncover clues to a possible terrorist attack at a New Delhi hotel and they race there to foil it.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: An Indian general decides to hold off on the assault on a New Delhi hotel that has been under siege when he learns that Scott and Stoneridge are in the hotel and they have ID'd the weapons scientist known as Mahmood.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Section 20 tracks Latif to South Africa, when a former IRA terrorist Daniel Connolly, targets a weapons-system designer. Scott switches places with a computer hacker and finds himself being lured into a dangerous honey trap.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Scott manages to pass Connolly's explosive test and works on bypassing a security code. Bratton contacts Marshall.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: There is trouble looming for Claire. Scott and Stonebridge attempt to locate a global arms dealer.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Grant travels to Khartoum when Sinclair and Scott are arrested. Clare is offered a choice by Tahir of either death or starting a new life as his partner. Stonebridge blames himself for Kate's death/ Crawford reveals that Latif has embedded a spy at the top of Western intelligence but refuses to reveal the person's identity until Clare is returned alive.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: An MI6 agent called John Allen ends up takeing Stonebridge and Scott from Vienna on a dangerous mission to Kosovo.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: In Kosovo, Stonebridge, Scott and four hostages find themselves in dire straits after being double-crossed by KFOR soldiers and the drug lord Hasani.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E09 - Episode 9
2.plot: Scott and Stonebridge head to Chechnya to track down Latif and a stockpile of chemical weapons.

2.title: FR - Strike Back - S02E10 - Episode 10
2.plot: In the season finale, Stonebridge and Scott are in a race against time to find a pair of suicide bombers targeting Budapest.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Damian Scott is sent to Mogadishu, Somalia to rescue British diplomats after they are kidnapped by warlord Huseyin Waabri. Meanwhile Michael Stonebridge adapts to his new career outside Section 20.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Scott learns that one of the hostages is a high-ranking military intelligence operative and that Waabri is planning to sell nuclear devices in South Africa.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Scott and Stonebridge track down a radical Islamic cleric in order to recover the nuclear devices, but are sidetracked by a CIA air strike and hostile locals.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Scott and Stonebridge prepare for an attack by Al Qaeda while holed up in an Algerian farmhouse with the nomad leader and the wounded courier. Meanwhile, back at headquarters, Dalton is called on the carpet for her relationship with the courier.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: The trail of the missing nuclear triggers leads to Cape Town, South Africa, where kidnappers abduct the children of an expatriate munitions expert to force him to cooperate.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Stonebridge seeks revenge on Craig Hanson after he turns up in Cape Town, South Africa. Meanwhile, Scott reconnects with a Mossad agent who's been following their case, but with a different set of orders; Knox hustles Evans to a secret installation and explains how he intends to turn his country into a world power.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: Knox extricates a political leader from a Zimbabwe prison, and the unit tries to catch up with the escapee by tracking his activist daughter.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E08 - Episode 8
3.plot: Unrest spreads after the assassination attempt on political leader Lutulu, while Stonebridge questions the shooter in an isolated police station and looks for a safe way out.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E09 - Episode 9
3.plot: Knox plans on unloading nuclear bombs into politically unstable African nations, while Matlock reveals why he joined Knox.

3.title: FR - Strike Back - S03E10 - Episode 10
3.plot: In order to stop Knox, Scott comes to Bryant for assistance. Meanwhile Stonebridge has trouble focusing on the mission as he is bent on revenge. Section 20 get assistance from South African police to stop Knox's plot.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: Enjoying a long-deserved vacation, Scott and Stonebridge are recalled after a fellow Section 20 member dies while pursuing the elusive terrorist al-Zuhari in Beirut. A new lead sends them into the remote jungles of Colombia in pursuit of a known associate of al-Zuhari’s and deep in territory controlled by a powerful drug cartel.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: Out of options and hunted by the resourceful cartel, Section 20 goes for a longshot and attempts an assault in downtown Bogota, hoping to obtain intel on one of al-Zuhari’s key people. Meanwhile, Dalton looks for the source that exposed her team in Beirut, but discovers a surprising ally and a piece of al-Zuhari’s plan.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Although they are uncertain of others’ loyalties, the team must work with an asset in Beirut to get a lead on James Leatherby, a dangerous and unpredictable operative with ties to al-Zuhari.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Section 20 attempts a risky rescue for a potential new ally. Now veering close to the edge, but determined to find the truth, Dalton goes AWOL with a detainee.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E05 - Episode 5
4.plot: While recovering from a shocking turn of events, Section 20 faces a different threat: a new enemy joining forces with an old one. Locke draws Kamali in closer to the team. Scott looks for an old friend, while Stonebridge gets closer to a new one.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: Section 20 is torn between devoting their resources to the mission or saving one of their own. Stonebridge's health continues to affect him in the field. Al-Zuhari's network moves forward quickly, striking close. Kamali explains why yet another threat is emerging.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E07 - Episode 7
4.plot: The team tracks stolen property to Russia, where Scott and Stonebridge continue their side careers as "outlaws." As Stonebridge's health continues to deteriorate, they discover new mysteries about a piece of Al-Zuhari's plan. Kamali worries that his cover identity may not hold.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E08 - Episode 8
4.plot: Scott looks for an escape from Black Bear Prison, while Locke becomes suspicious of Kamali. The team races to locate Stonebridge, whose condition grows more dire when he encounters Al-Zuhari's plan firsthand. Continuing his vendetta, Ulyanov closes in on Scott and Stonebridge.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E09 - Episode 9
4.plot: Scott and Stonebridge try to keep their promise to protect Ester; Richmond and Martinez follow an Al-Zuhari associate; the team sets out to stop an infiltrator before he reaches a populated area.

4.title: FR - Strike Back - S04E10 - Episode 10
4.plot: Scott and Stonebridge face a new pivotal player in Al-Zuhari's plan, and with an imminent attack looming, the team resorts to questionable measures, sparking conflict within the unit.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: The daughter of Thailand's British ambassador is kidnapped, so Stonebridge, Scott and the rest of the team sign up for another do-or-die trying adventure.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: Section 20 try to track down the real culprits behind the embassy attack, starting with getting information from gangster Ray McQueen.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Locke works out that his long-time friend is working with the dangerous Yakuza and Office 39. Scott needs protect his son after they find themselves enemy fire.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Scott has a serious talk with his son whilst the rest of Section 20 form an uneasy alliance with a couple of CIA mercenaries as they go after Shiro and Mei Foster.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E05 - Episode 5
5.plot: Scott and Stonebridge make a major mistake and fall into the clutches of North Korean agent Li-Na, leaving Locke having to defy orders to get them out.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E06 - Episode 6
5.plot: Scott and Stonebridge make a major mistake and fall into the clutches of North Korean agent Li-Na, leaving Locke having to defy orders to get them out.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E07 - Episode 7
5.plot: The battle with Li-Na is now in Europe, as Section 20 look for a way to get back on her trail. Locke ends up getting an unexpected chance to confront his nemesis.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E08 - Episode 8
5.plot: The team find out that Li-Na is planning to mount a nuclear attack in Europe. Locke puts himself in the firing line after he neglects the mission in order to avenge his son's murder.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E09 - Episode 9
5.plot: Locke takes Section 20 off the radar, as they defy Whitehall to travel to Geneva where he is convinced that Li-Na and Kwon are preparing to attack the United Nations HQ.

5.title: FR - Strike Back - S05E10 - Episode 10
5.plot: Scott and Stonebridge are stranded in the Alps with the mercenaries in pursuit. Scott knows that the CIA hide weapons caches across Europe, so they find a telephone at the farm of a retired Austrian soldier Oscar (Wolf Kahler) to call Christy Bryant (Stephanie Vogt), a past acquaintance from Vengeance, for the location of the nearest one, at a nearby dam.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E01 - Episode 1
6.plot: A dangerous terrorist is on the loose and it's up to Section 20 to find him.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E02 - Episode 2
6.plot: Section 20 start to close in on terrorist Omair Idrisi and his wife Jane Lowry, but the team is forced to extract devious arms dealer Morgan Ives from Libya.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: As Jane Lowry surfaces in Budapest, Mac and Wyatt are forced to go undercover to infiltrate a dangerous group of white supremacists that has something she needs.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: Things aren't looking good for Mac. He's blown his cover and is now facing certain death. Donovan digs into Zarin's past... and she doesn't like what she learns.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E05 - Episode 5
6.plot: Section 20 must stop Lowry and Dr Markov from making and unleashing a deadly chemical weapon. In desperate need of intel, Novin infiltrates a drug lord's home.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E06 - Episode 6
6.plot: Locked, loaded and set to resume their high-stakes mission, Section 20 are back. And they've got a big problem on their hands.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E07 - Episode 7
6.plot: It's Section 20 vs Jane Lowry in a race to get to Omair Idrisi. It's a mission that hurls comms officer Jensen into extreme danger. Contains sexual scenes.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E08 - Episode 8
6.plot: Watch out for a massive twist as Jensen digs into Project Tenebrae. Things don't go to plan for Mac and Wyatt as they storm a black site in search of Idrisi.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E09 - Episode 9
6.plot: The team run into trouble as they race to get Idrisi back across Europe. The surprises keep coming as they learn the truth about Jensen and Project Tenebrae.

6.title: FR - Strike Back - S06E10 - Episode 10
6.plot: Section 20 are desperate to clear their names. And to do so, they hatch a big and wreckless plan.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E01 - Episode 1
7.plot: Reuniting for what they think is a routine "cleanup" exercise in Malaysia, Gracie Novin, Samuel Wyatt and Thomas "Mac" McAllister learn that a British operative in possession of intel about a downed Russian plane has been killed in Kuala Lumpur.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E02 - Episode 2
7.plot: Section 20 forges an uneasy alliance with Zarkova in hopes of tracking down a stolen nuclear warhead in Kuala Lumpur; the group grows frustrated when Police Inspector Amy Leong pulls them off the job after a false alarm.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E03 - Episode 3
7.plot: Section 20's search for the missing nuclear warhead leads them to India, where three scientists have been kidnapped by a militant; the team gains valuable intel on Anjali Vartak, a rich Hindu with a personal vendetta against Muslims.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E04 - Episode 4
7.plot: As Wyatt is tortured by Vartak's henchmen, Mac presses her corrupt lawyer to hand over an encrypted hard drive that might hold clues to the whereabouts of a pair of "nuclear suitcases."

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E05 - Episode 5
7.plot: Following a high-speed jungle ambush in Myanmar, the suitcase nukes end up in the hands of a brutal Rwandan drug lord with a jealous streak; Colonel Beshnov, the Russian Alpha Group leader, surprises Pavel with a revelation about Zarkova.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E06 - Episode 6
7.plot: Novin and Zarkova find themselves at the mercy of corrupt police, while Mac and Wyatt take temporary refuge in a local village; Coltrane finally learns the location of the suitcase nukes, but the revelation comes at a high price.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E07 - Episode 7
7.plot: As Wyatt convalesces, Coltrane, Mac and Novin embark on a covert, 24-hour mission inside Russia to extract an FSB analyst with potentially vital information. Katrina questions Pavel's true identity, but chooses to stand by her commanding officer.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E08 - Revolution: Episode 8
7.plot: Coltrane defends his decision to go rogue with S20. After tailing Hassan and the nuclear suitcase to a deserted shopping mall in Jakarta, Wyatt and Novin face down threats from Komodo soldiers and, later, Colonel Aldo and his insurgents.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E09 - Episode 9
7.plot: In pursuit of Pavel, Section 20 clashes with two other Russian renegades, Natasha Petrenko and Artem Orlov, as they attempt to purchase sophisticated software designed to short-circuit a ghost satellite containing precious cargo.

7.title: FR - Strike Back - S07E10 - Revolution: Episode 10
7.plot: Section 20 faces an ultimate dilemma as it battles Pavel and his team of Russian turncoats for keys to Soviet-era missiles thought to have been destroyed years earlier.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E01 - Episode 1
8.plot: Section 20 are thrown back into combat when a rescue mission unleashes a conspiracy. Series eight of the action-chocked Sky original.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E02 - Episode 2
8.plot: A double cross turns an already dangerous mission deadly as Section 20 board an enemy-packed train to stop the bioweapon's sale.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E03 - Episode 3
8.plot: The team run into an old ally as they're thrown headlong into a dangerous race to stop the cyberweapon falling into Jihadist hands.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E04 - Episode 4
8.plot: Novin is in danger, but saving their soldier isn't Section 20's only mission. The enemy is closing in on the cyberweapon. Fast.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E05 - Episode 5
8.plot: The team race to stop Zayef from terrorist attack that could kill thousands. For Mac, the mission has never been more personal.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E06 - Episode 6
8.plot: Mac's life outside of the army might seem happy, but the emotional strain of what happened in Munich starts to take a heavy toll.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E07 - Episode 7
8.plot: Section 20 are sent on a military mission to Bosnia to grab a jihadi financier who could lead them to Zayef Hajdari.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E08 - Episode 8
8.plot: Section 20 successfully destroys the Albanian Mafia's weapons stash, but can they get the truth out of Zayef before it's too late?

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E09 - Episode 9
8.plot: CIA agent Carolyn Fortier convinces Section 20 to bring in their soldier alive, but the mission goes wrong when Russian forces arrive.

8.title: FR - Strike Back - S08E10 - Episode 10
8.plot: It's never been more personal. Section 20 embark on their final-ever mission as they fight to stop Arianna Demachi's plans in Europe.

meta.plot: Elevée dans la jungle depuis la mort de ses parents, Sheena a développé d'étranges pouvoirs lui permettant de se transformer à volonté, comme les Barbapapas, en n'importe quel animal. Ainsi elle peut se fondre dans la jungle et la défendre contre les nombreux individus qui veulent la détruire.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E01 - Sheena
1.plot: Sheena and Cutter meet for the first time in a most unusual way after Sheena sabotages Cutter's plane and it crashes down into the jungle.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E02 - Fallout
1.plot: After a U.S. defense department satellite crashes into the jungle, it's up to Sheena, Cutter and Cutter's old nemesis, Tyler, to track down and deprogram the satellite before the area is bombed by the military.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E03 - Revenge of the Jirds
1.plot: The cargo of coffee that Cutter was hired to deliver turns out to be a shipment of smuggled animals from the jungle known as Jirds.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E04 - A Rite of Passage
1.plot: A group of rogue gorillas terrorize villages throughout the jungle. As Sheena prepares to fight them off she discovers a secret Kali has been hiding. Consequently, Sheena must choose between her friend and the safety of her village.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E05 - Tourist Trap
1.plot: Cutter takes a group of tourists for the ride of their lives when they run into and are captured by a band of virus smugglers.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E06 - Buried Secrets
1.plot: A volcano in the LaMistas is causing seismic earthquakes. While rescuing animals from danger, Sheena finds an old stachel buried in the ground that triggers memories of her parents¹ death.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E07 - The Lost Boy
1.plot: When an evil corporation tries to steal the land of the peaceful Souman tribe, Sheena helps them fight back.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E08 - Wild Thing
1.plot: Sheena is trapped in a half-animal state and it's up to Cutter to find her before an obsessed trophy hunter gets to her first.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E09 - Doing as the Romans
1.plot: When N'Gama's troops kidnap a young woman from Kali's village for him to marry, Sheena must don western clothing and infiltrate N'Gama's palace to rescue the girl.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E10 - The Children of the LaMistas
1.plot: Sheena comes face to face with an old enemy. As she plans her revenge, she finds an old friend in trouble and uncovers a bizarre experiment.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E11 - Prey
1.plot: When Sheena enlists Cutter's help to stop the illegal rare game hunt, she finds that the animals aren't the only ones being pursued.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E12 - Divas of the Jungle
1.plot: Cutter is in heaven when some supermodels need his guidance through the jungle for a photo shoot. But when the photographer turns the shoot into a rescue operation, not everyone is who they seem to be.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E13 - Forbidden Fruit
1.plot: Sheena and Cutter, on a search for two missing botanists in a remote and highly dangerous part of the LaMistas, find a very hostile environment with a secret that could pit them against each other in a fight to the death.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E14 - The Fool Monty
1.plot: When a well-known TV icon captures footage of the Darak'Na for his show, sparking a tribal war, it's up to Sheena to keep the peace, and her secret, intact.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E15 - Sanctuary
1.plot: A civil war breaks out in Kamdeera when a rebel army takes over part of the country. Sheena and Cutter are caught in the middle, between rescuing refugees trapped in a sanctuary and helping a small force of UN soldiers, cut off from back-up battle the rebels. The situation looks bleak, but Sheena's got plans of her own.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E16 - Jewel
1.plot: Sheena steals Cutter's prized signed footballs to coerce him into helping her find the Kamada tribe's sacred jewel.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E17 - Friendly Fire
1.plot: Sheena's old friend, Tuli, returns to the LaMistas in search of a plant that may cure radiation poisoning. But when Tuli is gravely injured by her cutthroat rival, Sheena is compelled to put aside her resentment and save her friend's life.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E18 - Between a Rock and a Hard Place
1.plot: When Tuma, the leader of the Kiptalamis, attacks a peaceful meeting between the leaders of the four tribes, Sheena discovers that he wants sole ownership of a sacred rock shared by the tribes and will kill any one who gets in the way of his destiny.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E19 - Tyler Returns
1.plot: When a young friend of Sheena's is killed in a bombing, Cutter's old friend Tyler reappears to lead a mission to assassinate the terrorist responsible.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E20 - Unsafe Passage
1.plot: When an attack on the village leads to Kali's kidnapping, can Sheena rescue her before she is sold into modern day slavery without become a prisoner herself?

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E21 - Marabunta
1.plot: Sheena and Cutter find themselves surrounded by billions of killer ants which block their every means of escape.

1.title: FR - Sheena - S01E22 - Cult of One
1.plot: When a young girl and a government official die in a fiery car bomb, Sheena discovers a religious cult with murderous intent.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E01 - Rendezvous
2.plot: Sheena's efforts to save an Interpol agent from a ruthless drug lord spark a romance.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E02 - The Feral King
2.plot: Sheena and Cutter are enlisted to hunt for a jungle boy who is the heir to a fortune.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E03 - Mind Games
2.plot: Kali faces off against an old nemesis that tries to gain control over Sheena in order to exert domination over all the LaMistas.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E04 - Collateral Damage
2.plot: Sheena and Cutter befriend a CIA sniper who is the target of some rogue intelligence operatives.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E05 - Meltdown in Maltaka
2.plot: Cutter and Mendelsohn team up to help a female boxer to realize her dream of being a champion.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E06 - The Treasure of Sienna Mende
2.plot: A female jewel thief helps Cutter and Sheena locate a hidden treasure that could help a drought-stricken tribe.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E07 - The Darkness
2.plot: A mythic rogue beast is enlisted in an effort to steal a large government payroll.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E08 - Still Hostage After All These Years
2.plot: When a terrorist kidnapping threatens an important peace mission and stops the flow of a lifesaving vaccine to the village, Cutter's ex-wife is called in to negotiate.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E09 - Return of the Native
2.plot: Jealousy arises when Sheena's first love returns to Maltaka to open a long awaited school.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E10 - The Maltaka Files
2.plot: Alleged UFO sightings expose an attempt to sell illicit uranium to the highest bidder.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E11 - Stranded in the Jungle
2.plot: As the participants in a multi-million-dollar survival game are endangered by a coup, Sheena meets someone who might provide some important clues about her past.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E12 - Coming to Africa
2.plot: Sheena and Cutter protect a princess from a plot to disrupt her arranged marriage.

2.title: FR - Sheena - S02E13 - The World According to Mendelsohn
2.plot: Mendelsohn is asked to help a tribe that thinks he is a legendary wise man.

1.plot: Ten strangers are drawn away from their lives to an isolated rock off the Devon coast.

1.title: FR - Agatha Christie - Dix petits nègres - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As the sun rises and sets on the island and its solitary mansion, the number of guests is whittled down by their invisible enemy – to seven, to six, to five…

1.title: FR - Agatha Christie - Dix petits nègres - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Cut down to half their original number, the guests of Soldier Island are in danger of losing their minds to fear and anxiety.

Adèle Zimmer, psychologue talentueuse, rejoint la police fédérale comme consultante sur les cas de disparitions inquiétantes. Son fils a disparu il y a 6 mois mais elle n’a pas abandonné sa propre enquête. Elle va devoir faire équipe avec l’inspecteur Luca Dosco, un flic impulsif mais qui respecte les règles. Adèle, au contraire, pratique des méthodes peu orthodoxes pour résoudre une affaire. Et son talent pour percer les gens à jour fait ses preuves. Ce duo improbable, et que tout oppose, va devoir s’apprivoiser pour mener à bien leurs enquêtes.

meta.plot: Ils veulent vivre heureux, avec beaucoup d’enfants, mais ce ne sera pas tous les jours un conte de fées ! Avec la naissance de leur premier bébé ensemble, Samia et Nicolas rêvent de former un foyer serein, paisible et harmonieux. Mais le quotidien s’annonce plus compliqué que prévu et les obstacles nombreux… A commencer par le choix du prénom du nouveau-né qui se transforme en véritable cassetête. Car chez les Rousseau-Bensaid, outre Samia et Nicolas, il faut aussi compter avec les frères, les sœurs, les ex, les grands-parents, les copains… Des gens aussi sympathiques qu’envahissants. Il sera difficile d’accorder tout ce petit monde et de faire régner l’harmonie dans cette nouvelle famille.
